articles.title: CurveShift: Is Agent Progress Scalar? Separating Level from Shape
articles.abstract: Progress in large language models is often summarized using a single scalar measure, such as a time horizon, a latent ability estimate, or an aggregate benchmark score. These summaries capture the overall performance, but they do not test whether progress is distributed differently across task difficulty. We find that most of the apparent shift in gains toward harder tasks does not reflect a change in the shape of the difficulty-response curve. On METR time-horizon data, a single Rasch model with rising ability reproduces this pattern, so it is largely explained by ceiling effects rather than a qualitative change in capability. This echoes how the choice of metric can make claimed emergent abilities look like a property of the models themselves. We then identify a smaller hard-task effect that survives this control. Isolating it is difficult on agentic benchmarks, because newer models are usually run with newer agentic harnesses, so a gain on hard tasks cannot be assigned to the model or its scaffold. We break the confound with LiveCodeBench, a public competitive programming benchmark that runs no agentic scaffold while pairing dated models with an exogenous difficulty ordering. After accounting for the rise in overall ability, models released after September 2024 still gain on the hardest problems beyond what their easy and medium performance predicts, by about +0.40 logits under our most conservative assumption, raising the hard-problem solve rate from roughly 18% to 25%. The effect is led by the strongest reasoning models and holds for hard tasks that need only short reasoning, not autonomy over long horizons. We present this as a result specific to competitive programming, since our clean identification rests on a single coding benchmark. We release the LiveCodeBench Difficulty Panel (66 dated models x 1,055 problems) and our analysis code.

articles.titleCn: 曲线偏移：代理进度是否为标量？区分级别与形状
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的进展通常使用单一标量指标来总结，例如时间跨度、潜在能力评估或综合基准分数。这些总结捕捉了整体性能，但它们并未检验进展是否在不同任务难度上分布不同。我们发现，向更难任务转移的明显收益大部分并未反映难度-反应曲线形状的变化。在METR时间跨度数据上，单一的Rasch模型通过能力提升能够重现这一模式，因此这主要是由天花板效应解释，而非能力的质变。这印证了指标选择如何使声称的涌现能力看起来像是模型本身的属性。我们随后识别出一个较小的难任务效应，该效应在控制后依然存在。在自主基准上分离它很困难，因为较新的模型通常使用较新的自主框架运行，因此难任务的收益无法归因于模型或其支架。我们通过LiveCodeBench打破了这种混杂，这是一个公开的竞争性编程基准，它不运行任何自主框架，并将过时的模型与外部的难度排序配对。在考虑整体能力提升后，2024年9月之后发布的模型在预测其简单和中等表现之外的最难问题上仍有收益，在最保守的假设下，收益约为+0.40逻辑单位，将难问题解决率从约18%提升至25%。该效应主要由最强逻辑推理模型驱动，并且适用于只需短逻辑推理的难任务，而非长期自主性的任务。我们将其作为特定于竞争性编程的结果呈现，因为我们的清晰识别依赖于单一编码基准。我们发布了LiveCodeBench难度面板（66个过时模型 x 1,055个问题）和我们的分析代码。

articles.title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
articles.abstract: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.
articles.titleCn: 贝叶斯推理与动机推理在人工智能代理中
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能代理越来越多地在结论可以指导重要决策的情境中执行开放式任务。我们提供了证据，表明人工智能代理在实质性框架变化时，会从相同的数值数据中得出不同的结论。我们通过保持证据不变，而改变证据出现的情境，在医疗、选举取证和地缘政治预测等高风险领域展示了这种行为。在十二个代理-领域比较中，代理的结论受到其先前信念的强烈影响。当框架围绕其已认为可能命题时，它们更有可能得出肯定结论；而当框架与其先前信念冲突时，则相反。框架还会改变某些代理的工作方式：它们会进行更广泛的搜索，选择不同的分析规格，并以不同的方式评估相同证据。这些结果指出了将决策权委托给人工智能代理的一个特定风险，因为它们的决策可能取决于任务中未指定且决策记录中也无法看到的先前信念。

articles.title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

articles.titleCn: RMSWeb：用于网络智能体强化学习的反射、失效模式挖掘和残值DS
articles.abstractCn: 紧凑型网络代理可以降低部署成本，但在数据收集和SFT（监督微调）后的强化学习（RL）训练中存在挑战。成功轨迹的收集成本高昂，且往往包含低效的迂回。在SFT后，完整轨迹语料库主要由常规状态主导；此外，当将组相对RL应用于网络动作时，设计不当的动作级奖励会产生微弱或误导性的相对更新，而那些被判定不适合此类更新的组则无法获得后备学习信号。我们提出了RMSWeb，这是一个针对8B和32B规模的Qwen3-VL-Instruct的三部分方案。反射条件重试提高了收集效率并缩短了成功轨迹；失效模式挖掘将离线RL集中于SFT策略暴露的关键状态；Salvage-DS结合了动作语义极化奖励、对比竞争门控动态采样以及针对被拒绝组的动作仅锚点。使用反射收集数据训练的策略在解决任务时最多减少19.7%的动作步骤。在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench上，RMSWeb在8B规模上比SFT提升2.4-7.0分，在32B规模上提升1.2-7.7分。我们的8B模型在我们的比较中同类开放权重模型中实现了最强的Online-Mind2Web结果，并在WebVoyager和WebTailBench上报告了领先的准确度成本权衡，但需注意外部评估协议存在差异。

articles.title: SeDeM: Selective Decompression of Hidden-State Memories for Long-Context Question Answering
articles.abstract: Long-context inference with large language models (LLMs) is costly: self-attention during prefill scales quadratically with sequence length, and the key-value (KV) cache grows with the number of processed tokens. Larger context windows also do not ensure reliable evidence use. Context compression reduces this cost, but many soft-compression methods use LLMs as compressors and rely on compact memory tokens both to preserve information and to condition the decoder. We propose SeDeM, a selective decompression framework that decouples compact memory storage from decoder conditioning. An LLM extracts hidden states from a chosen intermediate Transformer layer, a lightweight compressor stores them as memory blocks, a query-conditioned selector selects relevant blocks, and a decompressor expands only the selected blocks into hidden states compatible with an intermediate decoder layer. Thus, the decoder avoids both full-context processing and direct generation from highly compressed memory slots. On four long-context QA benchmarks, SeDeM achieves higher QA scores than the evaluated compression baselines in both 1B and 3B same-backbone settings, and with the 3B backbone exceeds full-context fine-tuning on three datasets. The learned selector uses block-level evidence supervision during training. SeDeM also reduces online time-to-first-token and improves autoregressive decoding throughput relative to ICAE.
articles.titleCn: SeDeM：用于长上下文问答的隐藏状态记忆选择性解压缩
articles.abstractCn: 使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行长上下文推理成本高昂：在预填充阶段，自注意力机制的计算复杂度随序列长度呈平方级增长，而键值（KV）缓存的大小随处理过的token数量增长。更大的上下文窗口也无法确保可靠证据的使用。上下文压缩可以降低这种成本，但许多软压缩方法将LLMs用作压缩器，并依赖紧凑的内存token来保存信息以及为解码器进行条件化。我们提出了SeDeM，一种选择性解压缩框架，将紧凑内存存储与解码器条件化解耦。LLM从选定的中间Transformer层提取隐藏状态，一个轻量级压缩器将它们存储为内存块，一个查询条件化的选择器选择相关的块，一个解压缩器仅将选定的块扩展为与中间解码器层兼容的隐藏状态。因此，解码器避免了全上下文处理和直接从高度压缩的内存槽生成。在四个长上下文问答基准测试中，SeDeM在1B和3B相同主干设置下，问答分数均高于评估的压缩基线，并且使用3B主干时，在三个数据集上超过了全上下文微调。学习到的选择器在训练过程中使用块级证据监督。与ICAE相比，SeDeM还减少了在线首次token生成时间，并提高了自回归解码吞吐量。

articles.title: Abstention as an Action Can Kill Both the Reward Gradient and the KL Anchor: Collapse Law and Repair for Error-Penalized Reinforcement Learning

authors.name: Yuchen Yuan
authors.affiliation: $+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining

authors.name: Weida Zhao
authors.affiliation: among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout

authors.name: Chenyang Yu
authors.affiliation: $+1$ for a correct answer, $-\lambda$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining

articles.abstract: Error-penalized scoring rules ($+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining) are increasingly prescribed against hallucination: a rational agent facing such a rule answers exactly when its correctness probability exceeds Chow's threshold $t^\ast=λ/(1+λ)$. We prove that a KL-anchored gradient learner can do the opposite. When abstention is a discrete action, the reward gradient and the anchor's restoring force are throttled by the same gate-saturation factor and die together: under explicit conditions (among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout) the model drifts toward refusing everything, its mean training reward rising to zero like $1/t$ in training time $t$, so the curve reads as improvement while coverage collapses. The advantage estimator compounds the failure: in its sparse-answer regime, group normalization silently replaces every designed penalty with an effective penalty of one, moving the learned threshold from $t^\ast$ to $1/2$. The repair is structural: train a mandatory confidence report with a strictly proper score plus a correctness reward, and abstain only at deployment by thresholding the report. The always-emitted report has no gate to saturate, so no shared factor can kill its reward gradient and its anchor together, and its calibrated optimum is attracting. Simulations confirm every prediction, and experiments on language models at two scales confirm the mechanism live: the rule silences questions the models demonstrably still solve within ten optimizer steps, an ablation isolates the cause, and report-level training raises coverage, accuracy, and calibration together.
articles.titleCn: 将行动视为弃权会同时摧毁奖励梯度和KL锚点：误差惩罚强化学习的坍缩定律与修复
articles.abstractCn: 带误差惩罚的评分规则（正确答案得+1分，错误答案扣-λ分，弃权得0分）越来越被用来对抗幻觉：一个理性智能体在面对这种规则时会精确地回答当其正确性概率超过Chow的阈值t∗=λ/(1+λ)。我们证明KL锚定梯度学习器可以做到相反。当弃权是一个离散动作时，奖励梯度和锚的恢复力受到相同的门限饱和因子限制而一同消失：在明确条件下（其中包括，全面回答在期望中失去分数，并提示共享有界读数），模型会漂移到拒绝一切的方向，其平均训练奖励像1/t一样在训练时间t中上升，曲线看似改进而覆盖率崩溃。优势估计器加剧了这个问题：在其稀疏回答模式下，组归一化默默地用有效惩罚1替换了设计的每一个惩罚，将学习到的阈值从t∗移动到1/2。修复是结构性的：训练一个带有严格适当分数加上正确性奖励的强制置信报告，并在部署时通过阈值报告来弃权。始终发出的报告没有门限饱和，所以没有共享因子能同时杀死其奖励梯度和锚，并且其校准最优值是吸引的。模拟证实了每一个预测，并且对两个尺度的语言模型的实验证实了该机制是活跃的：规则沉默了模型在优化器步骤内仍然能证明解决的那些问题，一个消融实验隔离了原因，并且报告级训练共同提高了覆盖率、准确性和校准。

articles.title: Comparing and Modeling Argumentation in German Political Communication across Arenas

authors.name: Johannes Kühling
authors.affiliation: argument and their justifications, both their boundaries and their categories

authors.name: Sebastian Haunss
authors.affiliation: plenary speeches, committee meetings, and press conferences

articles.abstract: Deliberation, involving the formulation and exchange of arguments, forms an integral part of political decision making in democracies. Argumentation patterns however differ substantially across different political arenas, such as plenary speeches and committee meetings. However, despite a lot of interest in argumentation, there is comparatively little computational work on analyzing differences in patterns of political argumentation between arenas. Our work addresses this research gap. First, we present a 17k-sentence corpus with annotation for argumentative passages (argument and their justifications, both their boundaries and their categories) across three German political arenas (plenary speeches, committee meetings, and press conferences), keeping the topic (COVID-19) constant. Our analysis of the corpus finds that contrary to expectations, justification by domain-specific expertise is more frequent in press conferences than in committee meetings. Second, we present a pilot study on automatically identifying such argumentative passages. The results show that boundaries are hard to pin down, and models predictions additionally suffer from confirmation bias.
articles.titleCn: 比较与建模德国政治传播中不同领域的论证
articles.abstractCn: 审议，涉及论点的制定与交流，是民主政体中政治决策不可或缺的一部分。然而，论辩模式在不同政治领域（如全体会议发言和委员会会议）之间存在显著差异。尽管论辩研究备受关注，但针对不同政治领域间政治论辩模式差异的计算分析相对较少。我们的研究填补了这一研究空白。首先，我们构建了一个包含17k句的语料库，对三个德国政治领域（全体会议发言、委员会会议和新闻发布会）中的论辩段落进行标注（包括论点及其论证的边界和类别），并保持主题（COVID-19）不变。我们的语料库分析发现，与预期相反，新闻发布会中的领域特定专业知识论证比委员会会议更为频繁。其次，我们进行了一项自动识别此类论辩段落的初步研究。结果表明，边界难以确定，模型的预测还受到确认偏误的影响。

articles.title: Sixteen models, fewer than two voices: measuring ensemble dispersion where no answer is uniquely correct
articles.abstract: Sixteen language models drawn from ten families produced, on average, the semantic diversity of 1.69 distinct formulations of a psychotherapeutic case, against a single-model baseline of 1.43 from one model's own runs. Ensembles place more than one reading before a decision-maker on the premise that several models supply several perspectives. Dispersion over their outputs is measured both as diversity and as uncertainty, and both traditions validate it against a correctness criterion that this task does not admit. Measuring diversity is a solved problem: the Vendi Score, the exponential of the von Neumann entropy of a similarity matrix, is an effective number of distinct elements. What a single aggregate does not say is where the diversity comes from. We define a per-model dissent contribution, the complement of a model's mean similarity to the other members of its ensemble: a magnitude from the same matrix, not a decomposition of the spectral index, whose maximum identifies the most divergent voice. Crossing model and case, we test as a preregistered hypothesis whether model identity accounts for a non-zero share of the variance in dissent, and characterise the structure that test detects. The panel formulated fifteen stratified vignettes, yielding 7,082 formulations for analysis. Model identity was a detectable structuring factor of the dissent that remained, but the usual categories recovered it only partly: scale differences pointed in opposite directions across pairs, family grouped models on only five two-member lines, and the most divergent voice changed with panel composition, so that the surfaced outlier describes the ensemble rather than the model. Dissent did not track the interpretive openness for which the case bank was stratified; it was organised by clinical content instead, leaving the dispersion an ensemble produces a property to measure rather than assume.

articles.titleCn: 十六个模型，少于两种声音：在没有任何答案唯一正确的环境中测量合奏分散度
articles.abstractCn: 来自十个系列的十六种语言模型平均生成了1.69个不同的心理治疗案例表述，而单一模型基线仅从该模型自身运行中产生了1.43个。集成模型在决策者面前提供多个解读的前提是，多个模型提供多个视角。它们输出的分散程度既被测量为多样性，也被测量为不确定性，并且两种传统都根据这一任务不允许的正确性标准来验证它。测量多样性是一个已解决的问题：Vendi分数，即相似度矩阵冯·诺依曼熵的指数，是不同元素的有效数量。单个总体所不能说明的是多样性来自何方。我们定义了每个模型的异议贡献，即模型在其集成中与其他成员的平均相似度的补数：这是一个来自同一矩阵的量度，而不是频谱指数分解，其最大值确定了最不同的声音。跨越模型和案例，我们作为预先注册的假设测试，模型身份是否解释了异议中非零方差的一部分，并描述了测试检测到的结构。小组制定了十五个分层情景，产生了7082个表述用于分析。模型身份是剩余异议的可检测的结构因素，但通常类别只能部分恢复它：尺度差异在成对之间指向相反方向，系列仅在五条双成员线上对模型进行分组，并且最不同的声音随着小组组成的改变而改变，因此表面上的异常值描述的是集成而不是模型。异议没有跟踪案例库分层所针对的解释开放性；它是由临床内容组织的，这使得集成产生的分散成为需要测量的属性，而不是假设的属性。

articles.title: LoopsBench: From Harness Engineering to Loop Engineering in Benchmarking Coding Agent
articles.abstract: Coding agent infrastructure is shifting from harness engineering toward loop engineering as coding agents are deployed for sustained long-horizon software development. Existing benchmarks often center on localized tasks or end-state outcomes, offering limited insight into sustained execution. We introduce LOOPSBENCH, a long-horizon benchmark for loop engineering in coding agent evaluation. Each task is a dependency DAG over separately testable development units with source-evidenced prerequisite edges. LOOPSBENCH comprises 112 tasks from authentic sources spanning 8 programming languages and 9 domains. Its flow-aware runtime releases tests along the ready frontier and retains completed nodes as regression obligations. We evaluate frontier coding agents paired with widely used loop implementations. The strongest configuration, Opus-4.7 with Claude Code and outer continuation, resolves 25.00% of tasks. Recorded plans recover only part of the source-recovered prerequisite DAG, and regression events remain visible across the evaluated loop profiles. We open source the benchmark data and code, including all tasks, more than 5,300 development units, and executable tests, at microsoft/Loopsbench.
articles.titleCn: LoopsBench：从测试工具工程到循环工程在基准测试编码代理
articles.abstractCn: 随着编码代理被部署用于持续性的长时程软件开发，编码代理的基础设施正在从 harness 工程转向 loop 工程。现有的基准测试通常集中于局部任务或最终状态结果，对持续执行过程提供的洞察有限。我们引入了 LOOPSBENCH，这是一个用于编码代理评估中 loop 工程的长时程基准测试。每个任务都是一个依赖有向无环图（DAG），其开发单元可分别测试，且具有源代码证据的先决条件边。LOOPSBENCH 包含了 112 个来自真实来源的任务，涵盖 8 种编程语言和 9 个领域。其流感知运行时沿着就绪前沿释放测试，并将已完成的节点保留为回归义务。我们评估了前沿编码代理与广泛使用的 loop 实现的配合。最强的配置，Opus-4.7 配合 Claude Code 和外部延续，解决了 25.00% 的任务。记录的计划仅部分恢复了源代码证据的先决条件 DAG，回归事件在评估的 loop 配置中仍然可见。我们开源了基准测试数据和代码，包括所有任务、超过 5,300 个开发单元和可执行测试，托管在 microsoft/Loopsbench。

articles.title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
articles.abstract: Do frontier vision-language models present a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across tasks, matching the same human reference group, or does that profile fragment from one paradigm to the next? We evaluate a shared panel of nine frontier VLMs on two psychology-derived benchmarks: the Keysar Director Task (visual perspective-taking under egocentric interference) and the Frith-Happé animated triangles scored with the Castelli rubric (intention attribution from pure motion). On the Director Task, without chain-of-thought, the panel makes the egocentric error on 78\% of trials like children rather than adults; variation is substantial across models, and reasoning rescues several models. On the triangles, the panel under-attributes intention: its ToM profile sits more than three times closer to the high-functioning-autistic-adult (HF-ASD) mean than to the typical-development-adult (TD) mean, while Goal-Directed and Random stay near TD. No model is nearest TD on both tasks; the model that looks adult-like on the Director Task falls on the HF-ASD side on the triangles, and the most TD-like model on the triangles is child-like on the Director Task. We report group-level descriptions, not diagnostic labels for any model.
articles.titleCn: 跨任务解离在前沿视觉-语言模型心智理论
articles.abstractCn: 前沿视觉语言模型在各项任务中是否展现出一致的心智理论（Theory-of-Mind, ToM）特征，并与相同的人类参照群体相匹配，抑或其特征会随着范式不同而碎片化？我们评估了九个前沿视觉语言模型在两个心理学衍生基准上的表现：凯斯卡尔导演任务（在自我中心干扰下的视觉视角转换）和基于卡斯蒂利评分标准的弗里特-哈佩动画三角形任务（从纯粹运动中推断意图）。在导演任务中，没有进行思维链推理时，该模型组在78%的试验中出现自我中心错误，与儿童而非成人相似；模型间的差异很大，而思维链推理挽救了几个模型的表现。在三角形任务中，该模型组低估了意图的归属：其心智理论特征距离高功能自闭症成人（HF-ASD）均值超过典型发育成人（TD）均值的3倍，而目标导向和随机模型仍接近TD。没有模型在两项任务中都最接近TD；在导演任务中看似成人的模型在三角形任务中偏向HF-ASD，而在三角形任务中最接近TD的模型在导演任务中表现像儿童。我们报告的是群体层面的描述，而非任何模型的诊断标签。

articles.title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping
articles.titleCn: 基于验证器诱导的支持重塑在线策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 我们证明了带可验证奖励的政策强化学习（RLVR）能够提升当前目标，但同时使针对后续目标的成功行为变得稀少，难以采样和强化。我们将这种现象称为验证器诱导的支持重塑，并将有效的可奖励支持定义为在固定策略预算内可达的成功轨迹。在两个模型族中，我们通过重复验证器评分采样和双向训练来研究这一效应，包括使用相反验证器的顺序训练，涵盖数学推理和约束指令遵循任务。Math-RLVR提升了平均指令遵循成功率，但在重复采样下减少了任何成功响应的提示数量。在IFEval测试中，使用Qwen3-8B-Base模型，pass@1指标提升了6.5个百分点，而best@32指标下降了9.8个百分点，这种分歧在两个模型和IF基准测试中均出现。相反，IF-RLVR将数学响应从逐步引导转向直接回答，降低了不同采样预算下的best@k指标，并减少了后续Math-RLVR的奖励变化。标记分布分析和受控引导干预显示，这些变化主要集中在最初的几个响应标记上。RLVR主要重新排序基础策略中已有的引导选项，而选定的引导选项会直接影响数学搜索的可行性。测试的参考策略约束、路由先验和策略内蒸馏只能部分保留跨任务支持；MathIF和ReasonIF显示，边际收益只能部分转化为既正确又遵循约束的响应。因此，端点改进并不能保证未来在策略优化下的可训练性或联合能力。代码可在https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping获取。

articles.title: A Few Neurons Reveal When LLMs Misuse Tools: Sparse Detection and Selective Steering for Reliable Tool Use
articles.abstract: Agentic LLMs exhibit three consequential tool-use failures: invalid arguments (validity), unnecessary calls (over-calling), and omitted calls when tools are needed (missing). We find that a small, failure-specific set of MLP neurons could distinguish such failures with linearly separable decision boundaries. Building on this observation, we introduce PRISMS (Probing Representations In Support of Monitoring and Steering), a closed-loop framework that shares a failure-specific neuron basis between sparse detection and activation steering. PRISMS selects contribution-critical MLP neurons and fits an L1-regularized detector on their activations. Across six models from the Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma families, over-calling and missing are detected at the pre-generation prompt boundary with ROC-AUC 0.90-1.00, while validity is detected from the generated tool-call span with ROC-AUC 0.86-0.90. These results are achieved with highly sparse readouts: only 1-2 MLP neurons for missing, 2-16 for over-calling, and approximately 128 for validity. These sparse detectors match or outperform dense residual-stream baselines using 23-627 times fewer features. The shared neuron basis also supports bidirectional control over tool-calling behavior, suppressing unnecessary calls and eliciting omitted ones. PRISMS therefore gates intervention on predicted failure risk to mitigate the collateral effects of unconditional steering. Across all six models, PRISMS reduces pooled over-calling rate by 80% (from 0.131 to 0.026) while increasing tool-required accuracy by 14.2 percentage points (from 0.689 to 0.831). PRISMS thus provides lightweight failure detection and selective intervention across model families.
articles.titleCn: 一些神经元揭示大语言模型何时误用工具：稀疏检测和选择性引导以实现可靠工具使用
articles.abstractCn: 自主式大语言模型在工具使用方面表现出三种关键性失效：无效论点（有效性）、不必要的调用（过度调用）以及在需要工具时遗漏调用（遗漏）。我们发现，一小部分针对失效的MLP神经元能够通过线性可分决策边界区分这些失效。基于这一观察，我们引入了PRISMS（支持监控和引导的探测表示），这是一个闭环框架，在稀疏检测和激活引导之间共享失效特定的神经元基础。PRISMS选择贡献关键的MLP神经元，并在其激活上拟合L1正则化检测器。在Qwen3、Llama和Gemma系列的六个模型中，过度调用和遗漏在生成前提示边界被检测，ROC-AUC为0.90-1.00，而有效性从生成的工具调用跨度被检测，ROC-AUC为0.86-0.90。这些结果通过高度稀疏的读数实现：遗漏仅需1-2个MLP神经元，过度调用需2-16个，有效性需约128个。这些稀疏检测器使用的特征数比密集残差流基线少23-627倍，表现相当或更优。共享神经元基础还支持对工具调用行为的双向控制，抑制不必要的调用并触发遗漏的调用。因此，PRISMS通过预测失效风险来控制干预，以减轻无条件引导的附带影响。在所有六个模型中，PRISMS将总体过度调用率降低80%（从0.131降至0.026），同时将工具需求准确率提高14.2个百分点（从0.689升至0.831）。PRISMS因此为不同模型系列提供了轻量级的失效检测和选择性干预。

articles.title: Bridging the English-Arabic Medical Knowledge Gap: Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation via Causal Layer Selection
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly in English medical tasks but degrade substantially in Arabic, a gap widely attributed to limited training data. We systematically investigate this assumption via tuned lens probing and causal activation patching, and find that Arabic medical knowledge is present in intermediate model representations but fails to surface at the output. This mechanistic insight motivates a targeted adaptation strategy: rather than fine-tuning the full network, we propose Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation (TLoRA), restricted to the layer window where cross-lingual representations diverge, upstream of the output layers where the failure manifests. We evaluate TLoRA on multiple-choice medical QA, where our approach outperforms full-network LoRA, zero-shot, and few-shot baselines. We further evaluate it on short-answer generation and multi-turn clinical dialogue, where it performs competitively without the need for task-specific finetuning. We additionally introduce AraClinicDialog, a clinician-constructed Arabic medical dialogue benchmark in MSA with validated variants across four Arabic dialects. Together, these contributions demonstrate that mechanistic diagnosis can serve as a practical guide for targeted adaptation in underrepresented-language medical LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 弥合英阿医学知识鸿沟：基于因果层选择的靶向低秩自适应
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在英语医疗任务中表现优异，但在阿拉伯语任务中表现显著下降，这一差距通常被归因于训练数据的不足。我们通过调谐透镜探测和因果激活补丁，系统地研究了这一假设，发现阿拉伯语医疗知识存在于中间模型表示中，但未能出现在输出端。这一机制洞察启发了针对性的适应策略：我们不调整整个网络，而是提出了目标低秩适应（TLoRA），仅限于跨语言表示出现分歧的层窗口，以及输出层上游的失败表现层。我们在多项选择医疗问答任务上评估了TLoRA，我们的方法优于全网络LoRA、零样本和少样本基线。我们进一步在短答案生成和多轮临床对话任务上评估了它，其中它在无需特定任务微调的情况下表现出竞争力。此外，我们引入了AraClinicDialog，这是一个由临床医生构建的阿拉伯语医疗对话基准，在MSA中包含经过验证的四个阿拉伯方言变体。这些贡献共同表明，机制诊断可以作为在代表性不足语言的医疗LLMs中进行针对性适应的实用指南。

articles.title: Averaging Bias: Human Faithfulness Annotations are not Locally Faithful
articles.abstract: Evaluation of faithfulness of text summarization treats a model generated summary as faithful only if every of its sentences is supported by the source document: a strict conjunctive rule under which a single unsupported sentence makes the whole summary unfaithful. Yet most faithfulness benchmarks collect only one global human annotation label per summary. We ask whether such global human labels actually implement the conjunctive rule. We hypothesize that annotators may accept a summary as faithful when most sentences are faithful, not only when all are faithful. To test our hypothesis, we use five large language model (LLM) judges as per-sentence raters across four widely used faithfulness benchmarks. We find that global human labels correlate better with the average of per-sentence LLM judgments than with the implementation of the strict conjunctive rule. A manual review confirms that a substantial fraction of summaries labeled faithful by humans contain genuine local factual errors. We call this tendency Averaging Bias. Our results reveal that human labels on widely used faithfulness benchmarks contain measurable Averaging Bias, calling for carefully structured designs for trustworthy human annotations
articles.titleCn: 平均偏差：人类忠实度标注并非局部忠实
articles.abstractCn: 评估文本摘要的忠实性时，只有当模型生成的每句话都得到源文档支持时，才认为该摘要忠实：这是一个严格的合取规则，其中一句话不支持就会导致整个摘要不忠实。然而，大多数忠实性基准测试只收集每个摘要的一个全局人工标注标签。我们质疑这种全局人工标签是否真的实现了合取规则。我们假设，标注者可能在大多数句子忠实时接受摘要为忠实，而不仅限于所有句子都忠实。为了验证我们的假设，我们使用五个大型语言模型（LLM）作为句子级评分者在四个广泛使用的忠实性基准测试上进行了评估。我们发现，全局人工标签与句子级LLM判断的平均值相关性比与严格合取规则的实现相关性更高。人工复核证实，被人类标注为忠实的大量摘要中包含真实的局部事实错误。我们将这种倾向称为平均偏差。我们的结果表明，广泛使用的忠实性基准测试上的人工标签包含可测量的平均偏差，这要求对可信度的人工标注进行精心设计。

articles.title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
articles.abstract: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.
articles.titleCn: TRACE-TS：基于归因和可追溯的传感器语言推理的人体活动理解
articles.abstractCn: 可穿戴传感器能够捕捉精细的运动模式，从而支持丰富的行为理解，然而大多数现有方法将这些信号简化为活动标签。基于语言模型（LM）的最新方法为传感器数据生成自然语言解释，但其推理与底层信号的联系较弱，导致解释流畅但无法验证。我们提出了TRACE-TS（可追溯推理与归因证据），这是一个用于可穿戴时间序列的结构化、信号关联推理框架。TRACE-TS利用专家分类器的归因来识别显著的时空传感器区域，使用这些区域构建具有明确证据来源的有向无环图（DAG）推理轨迹，并训练一个紧凑的语言模型，通过门控交叉注意力机制在传感器内存标记上生成这些轨迹。在推理阶段，改进后的模型联合输出活动预测及其推理轨迹，无需归因计算或教师指导。我们引入了语义节点匹配（SNM），这是一种将语言模型作为评判者的度量标准，用于在观察、推理和综合层面诊断推理的保真度，能够定位标准自然语言生成（NLG）度量标准所遗漏的幻觉观察和断裂的证据链。在七个可穿戴基准测试中，TRACE-TS在所有评估方法中实现了最高的平均准确率和F1值（84.43%/81.24%），并在F1值上比最佳的基于语言模型的基线方法高出17.96%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS获取。

articles.title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
articles.abstract: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.
articles.titleCn: 一种用于数据高效强化学习对齐的宪法网格仪器（C-Guard）
articles.abstractCn: 在RL对齐中，冲突目标普遍存在，而高效地在这些目标上进行数据训练是困难的。使用RL训练安全防护意味着优化两个相互冲突的目标：捕获真实伤害，且不拒绝良性提示。我们的发现是，过度拒绝提升了22.4%至12.8%，而在对抗性攻击中沉默的拒绝则使0.27恶化至0.33。我们提出了C-Guard，一种宪法网格工具，用于生成RL训练数据，以及C-LIM，一种每单元可学习性评分，用于决定每个单元的行动：剪枝、致密化、修正、扩展。C-LIM在训练预算花费之前就标记了无效数据区域：187行未针对目标数据未带来任何收益，而我们的方法使该区域的学习影响从0.733提升至0.80。代码和宪法已开源。

articles.title: TokTier: Exact Stateful CPU+GPU Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving

authors.name: Zhichao Cao
authors.affiliation: $1.5\times10^{10}$ split checks, a 12.4TB real-text corpus, 93,000+ replayed agent steps

articles.abstract: LLM serving stacks cache prompt KV state, yet the front end still re-tokenizes the full request text on every call. Coding agents pay the most: each call resubmits a long transcript after a small append, and reuse is hard because a short append can move token boundaries near the end of the prior sequence. Across 153,951 agent calls, the median append is 1.4K characters; only 1.0-3.6% of calls start or rebuild a session, but those carry multi-million-character contexts. At the fleet's 94.1% prompt-cache hit rate approaching 0.99, tokenization grows from 10% to 64% of time to first token. TokTier is a stateful CPU+GPU tokenization service for this two-mode workload with one contract: emitted token IDs are always identical to full reference tokenization of the request text. For session continuations it re-tokenizes a small window around the append and splices only when a per-request check finds a stable pre-tokenization boundary, else it widens or falls back. For calls without a reusable prefix it decomposes GPT-family regex pre-tokenization into run-local rules and runs exact pre-tokenization and BPE on a GPU. A sampled shadow verifier re-checks live traffic. Differential campaigns over 17 production tokenizer families ($1.5\times10^{10}$ split checks, a 12.4TB real-text corpus, 93,000+ replayed agent steps) show zero divergence. Incremental repair takes 0.5-1.1ms from 100K to 3M characters, up to $437\times$ faster than HF tokenization and $2.1\times$ faster at 1M characters than the strongest cache-based baseline (Gigatoken) fully prewarmed. GPU full tokenization encodes 1M characters in 0.87ms, $491\times$ below HF and $23.4\times$ below the fastest published CPU method. With vLLM, median time to first token drops 16-34% and P99 23%; under a 50ms P99 objective, four repair cores plus one GPU sustain 1,821 requests/s where a 16-core stateless front end saturates at 40.

articles.titleCn: TokTier：面向智能体LLM服务的精确状态感知CPU+GPU分词技术
articles.abstractCn: LLM服务堆栈缓存提示键值状态，但前端每次调用仍对完整请求文本进行重新分词。编码代理承受最大负担：每次调用在少量追加后重新提交长篇文本，且重用困难，因为短追加可能使分词边界移至先前序列的末尾。在153,951次代理调用中，中位数追加为1.4K字符；仅有1.0-3.6%的调用开始或重建会话，但这些调用承载着数百万字符的上下文。在舰队94.1%的提示缓存命中率接近0.99时，分词时间从首次分词的10%增长到64%。TokTier是为这种双模式工作负载设计的有状态CPU+GPU分词服务，其唯一约定是：发出的分词ID始终与请求文本的完整参考分词相同。对于会话续接，它重新分词追加周围的小窗口，仅在请求级检查发现稳定的预分词边界时才拼接，否则会扩大或回退。对于没有可重用前缀的调用，它将GPT系列的预分词正则表达式分解为本地运行规则，并在GPU上运行精确预分词和BPE。采样的影子验证器重新检查实时流量。跨17个生产分词器家族（$1.5\times10^{10}$次分割检查、12.4TB真实文本语料库、93,000多次重放的代理步骤）的差异活动显示零偏差。增量修复从100K到3M字符耗时0.5-1.1ms，比HF分词快437倍，在1M字符时比最强的基于缓存的基线（Gigatoken）完全预热快2.1倍。GPU完整分词在0.87ms内编码1M字符，比HF快491倍，比最快的公开CPU方法快23.4倍。使用vLLM，首次分词中位数时间降低16-34%，P99降低23%；在50ms P99目标下，四个修复核心加一个GPU可维持1,821请求/s，而16核无状态前端在40时达到饱和。

articles.title: Evolving language compositionality in a frequency-structured meaning space
articles.abstract: The iterated learning model was introduced to investigate language evolution: the way in which the characteristic properties of human languages have been shaped, at least partly, by repeated transmission from one language user to another. The key finding is that language compositionality can arise spontaneously as a consequence of language being passed repeatedly through a language learning bottleneck. Here we explore how changing the frequency of different meanings, so that some meanings occur much more frequently than others, affects the character of its compositionality. We find that, as observed in natural languages, high-frequency meanings can escape the pressure to conform to the grammar that characterizes lower-frequency meanings. However, when the frequency structure is instead imposed on parts rather than on whole meaning vectors, the language fails to transmit across generations. This occurs despite the fact that the most frequent elements are reliably learned. These results suggest that frequency can shape emergent linguistic structure only when the frequency distribution is defined over form-meaning units that learners can acquire holistically. When frequency is instead distributed over smaller units, it fails to support the relational structure required for compositional generalisation, thereby preventing stable language transmission.

articles.titleCn: 在频率结构的意义空间中演化语言组合性
articles.abstractCn: 迭代学习模型被引入以研究语言进化：人类语言的特征属性至少部分地是通过反复从一种语言使用者传递到另一种语言使用者而形成的。关键发现是，语言组合性可以作为一种结果自发地产生，当语言反复通过语言学习瓶颈时。在这里，我们探讨了改变不同含义的频率，使得某些含义比其他含义出现频率高得多，如何影响其组合性的特征。我们发现，正如自然语言中观察到的那样，高频含义可以逃避遵循那些特征较低频含义的语法的压力。然而，当频率结构施加于部分而非整个含义向量时，语言无法在代际间传递。这种情况发生在尽管最频繁的元素被可靠地学习。这些结果表明，只有当频率分布在学习者可以整体习得的形式-含义单元上时，频率才能塑造涌现的语言结构。当频率分布在小单元上时，它无法支持组合泛化所需的关系结构，从而阻止了稳定语言传递。

articles.title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has shown strong promise for robotic manipulation. Among RL methods, critic-based approaches rely on a value estimator that predominantly operates on single-frame observations or single-frame VLM backbone latents, which is a fundamental mismatch with the partially observable nature of robot control. A naive approach to incorporate observation history into the critic incurs exponential complexity with high-dimensional visual space, and still fails because pure scalar-return regression provides insufficient supervision for learning cross-temporal dynamics. We identify the root cause as a state approximation problem: without an explicit world modeling objective, the critic's representation cannot capture the temporal structure needed for accurate value estimation. To address this, we propose the World Critic Model (WCM), built on a lightweight LeJEPA architecture; WCM jointly predicts future latent state and estimates values, such that the critic's representation is explicitly trained to capture temporal dynamics rather than merely regress scalar returns. WCM integrates seamlessly into both on-policy and off-policy training pipelines and is compatible with state-of-the-art VLA backbones including Pi0, Pi0.5, and OpenVLA-OFT. Extensive experiments on 149 tasks across four benchmarks demonstrate that WCM consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, with particularly strong generalization gains. We further validate WCM on seven real-world manipulation tasks using OpenVLA-OFT and Pi0.5 with off-policy RL, confirming stable deployment across diverse settings.
articles.titleCn: WCM：一种用于视觉-语言-行动强化学习的世界批判模型
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型的强化学习（RL）后训练在机器人操作领域展现出巨大潜力。在RL方法中，基于评价者的方法依赖于价值估计器，该估计器主要基于单帧观测或单帧VLM主干网络潜伏变量进行操作，这与机器人控制的非完全可观测性存在根本性不匹配。一种将观测历史纳入评价者的朴素方法在高维视觉空间中导致指数级复杂度，并且仍然失败，因为纯标量返回回归为学习跨时间动态提供了不足的监督。我们识别出根本原因是状态近似问题：在没有显式世界建模目标的情况下，评价者的表示无法捕捉用于准确价值估计所需的时间结构。为解决此问题，我们提出了基于轻量级LeJEPA架构的世界评价者模型（WCM）；WCM联合预测未来潜伏状态并估计价值，使得评价者的表示被明确训练以捕捉时间动态，而不仅仅是回归标量返回。WCM可以无缝集成到策略内和策略外训练流程中，并与包括Pi0、Pi0.5和OpenVLA-OFT在内的最先进的VLA主干网络兼容。在四个基准上的149项任务上的大量实验表明，WCM在分布内和分布外设置中始终实现最先进性能，并具有特别强的泛化增益。我们进一步使用OpenVLA-OFT和Pi0.5在七项真实世界操作任务上使用策略外RL验证WCM，确认其在不同设置中的稳定部署。

articles.title: FriendBench: Benchmarking Dyadic Familiarity Inference in Humans and Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Reading a social situation often depends on behavior, not words alone. We introduce FriendBench, a benchmark for inferring whether two people are already familiar or are meeting as strangers, from a 20-second clip of a dyadic ice-breaker conversation. Every pair answers the same type of prompt, so only the manner of interaction can reveal the answer. Across text, audio, and video, we compare 26 models from seven companies against matched human panels over 96 balanced dyads. The best model and the human crowd are statistically indistinguishable on accuracy in every modality, but reach it differently: humans stay balanced across the two answers, while the strongest models lean toward "stranger"---a difference in effective prior, not discrimination. Richer channels help both unequally, and only humans gain from visible behavior on top of speech. We release the stimuli, human ratings, and model predictions.
articles.titleCn: FriendBench：人类和多模态大型语言模型中二元熟悉度推理的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 解读社交情境往往依赖于行为，而不仅仅是言语。我们介绍了FriendBench，这是一个基准，用于从双人破冰对话的20秒片段中推断两个人是否已经熟悉或作为陌生人见面。每一对都回答相同类型的提示，因此只有互动的方式才能揭示答案。在文本、音频和视频方面，我们比较了来自七家公司的26个模型与96个平衡双人组的匹配人类小组。最佳模型和人类群体在每种模态的准确性上没有统计学上的区别，但实现方式不同：人类在两种答案上保持平衡，而最强的模型倾向于“陌生人”——这是一种有效先验的差异，而非区分能力。更丰富的渠道对双方的帮助是不平等的，只有人类在言语之上还能从可见行为中获益。我们发布了刺激物、人类评分和模型预测。

articles.title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
articles.abstract: KV cache compression is essential for efficient long-context inference. Existing eviction methods permanently discard unselected tokens and consequently remove their aggregate contribution to attention. Merging-based alternatives preserve more information but can perturb retained keys and values that should remain exact. We observe that the information omitted by cache eviction can be formulated as residual statistics in both the numerator and denominator of softmax attention. Based on this observation, we propose ResKV, which divides a fixed KV budget into an exact main cache and a compact residual cache that reconstructs the contribution of omitted tokens. ResKV lets main-cache tokens and residual entries participate in the same softmax normalization, so residual entries restore both attention numerator and denominator mass rather than acting as a post-hoc correction. A construction-time validation proxy determines residual allocation for each layer and KV head, while a decode-time dynamic gate adjusts residual contributions for individual queries. Comprehensive evaluations on LongBench and RULER, covering query-aware and query-agnostic settings, multiple backbones, cache budgets, and representative compression baselines, demonstrate broad improvements under the same retained KV budget while preserving the practical efficiency of compressed decoding, including peak memory usage and long-context decode throughput.
articles.titleCn: ResKV：重建固定预算KV缓存压缩中遗漏的注意力贡献
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存压缩对于高效的长期上下文推理至关重要。现有的淘汰方法会永久丢弃未被选中的token，从而移除它们对注意力的总体贡献。基于合并的替代方案虽然保留了更多信息，但可能会扰动应保持精确的保留键和值。我们观察到，缓存淘汰所忽略的信息可以表述为softmax注意力分子和分母中的残差统计。基于这一观察，我们提出了ResKV，它将固定的KV预算分为精确的主缓存和紧凑的残差缓存，用于重建被忽略token的贡献。ResKV让主缓存token和残差条目参与相同的softmax归一化，因此残差条目不仅恢复注意力分子和分母的质量，而不仅仅是作为事后校正。构建时的验证代理确定了每一层和KV头的残差分配，而解码时的动态门调整了单个查询的残差贡献。在LongBench和RULER上的全面评估，涵盖了查询感知和查询无关设置、多种骨干网络、缓存预算和代表性压缩基线，证明了在相同的保留KV预算下实现了广泛改进，同时保持了压缩解码的实际效率，包括峰值内存使用和长期上下文解码吞吐量。

articles.title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
articles.abstract: We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed. Rather than decoding one token at a time, DiffusionGemma iteratively refines blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, avoiding the sequential decoding bottleneck of conventional autoregressive (AR) large language models. Instead of training from scratch, we obtain DiffusionGemma by fine-tuning the mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with 3.8B activated and 25.2B total parameters. Our compute-efficient two-stage training pipeline uses fewer than 10% of the starting AR model's total training token budget. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to teach bidirectional denoising, while the second stage combines reinforcement learning with sampler distillation to jointly improve generation quality and inference efficiency. DiffusionGemma establishes a new Pareto frontier for the trade-off between generation speed and model capability. Averaged across our full evaluation suite, it generates around 20 tokens per forward pass and achieves roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, which is substantially faster than AR models even with state-of-the-art speculative decoding. DiffusionGemma also retains the starting model's support for thinking mode, multimodal inputs, and long contexts. Despite diffusion fine-tuning, it remains capable of AR generation with only minor performance degradation, suggesting a path toward hybrid diffusion-AR decoding.
articles.titleCn: 扩散Gemma技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了DiffusionGemma，这是一个使用离散扩散技术以极高速度生成文本的实验性开放权重语言模型。与逐个解码标记不同，DiffusionGemma并行迭代地细化256个标记的块，避免了传统自回归（AR）大型语言模型的顺序解码瓶颈。我们没有从头开始训练，而是通过微调具有38亿个激活参数和252亿个总参数的混合专家Gemma 4模型来获得DiffusionGemma。我们的计算高效的两阶段训练流程使用的总训练标记预算不到起始AR模型总预算的10%。第一阶段使用监督微调来教授双向去噪，第二阶段结合强化学习和采样器蒸馏，共同提高生成质量和推理效率。DiffusionGemma在生成速度和模型能力之间的权衡中建立了新的帕累托前沿。在我们的完整评估套件中，它每个前向传递大约生成20个标记，并在单个NVIDIA H100 GPU上实现约每秒1,500个输出标记，这比具有最先进推测解码的AR模型快得多。DiffusionGemma还保留了起始模型对思考模式、多模态输入和长上下文的支持。尽管进行了扩散微调，它仍然能够以轻微的性能下降进行AR生成，这表明了混合扩散-AR解码的路径。

articles.title: Sycophancy Undermines Epistemic Vigilance in Cooperative Vision-Language Tasks
articles.abstract: To maintain common ground in cooperative conversation, humans iteratively update their beliefs as conversation participants share new information; participants who are epistemically vigilant detect when new information conflicts with prior beliefs and take steps to repair these conflicts. In order for AI systems to serve as reliable partners in complex cooperative tasks, they must similarly weigh incoming information against their own private evidence and shared context and appropriately surface inconsistencies when they arise. To measure the epistemic vigilance of vision-language models in cooperative settings, we present an information-asymmetric, dialog-based "spot-the-difference" task. Two models are privately shown one image each, and must determine through conversation whether the images are identical or, if not, identify the difference. Models routinely fail at this: they frequently overlook key evidence in their private image in favor of agreeing with their conversational partner, even when their agreement is unwarranted. We relate these violations of epistemic vigilance to the broader behavior of sycophancy, which manifests itself in cooperative goal-oriented dialog as over-accommodation and weak evidential grounding. Our results show that model steering to reduce sycophancy with a vector learned from task-agnostic sycophancy examples can reduce epistemic vigilance-related errors, making models more faithful reporters of their evidence, and in turn, more reliable partners in information-asymmetric cooperative tasks.
articles.titleCn: 谄媚行为损害了合作式视觉-语言任务中的认知警觉性
articles.abstractCn: 为了在合作对话中保持共识，人类会随着对话参与者分享新信息而迭代更新他们的信念；具有知识警觉性的参与者会检测到新信息与先前信念的冲突，并采取措施修复这些冲突。为了让人工智能系统在复杂的合作任务中成为可靠的伙伴，它们也必须同样将接收到的信息与自身的私人证据和共享的上下文进行权衡，并在出现不一致时适当地揭示这些不一致。为了测量视觉语言模型在合作环境中的知识警觉性，我们提出了一种信息不对称、基于对话的“找出差异”任务。两个模型分别被私下展示一张图像，必须通过对话判断图像是否相同，如果不同，则识别差异。模型通常无法完成这个任务：它们经常为了与对话伙伴达成一致而忽略其私人图像中的关键证据，即使这种一致是不合理的。我们将这些知识警觉性违背与更广泛的自媚行为联系起来，自媚行为在合作目标导向的对话中表现为过度迁就和证据基础薄弱。我们的结果表明，通过从任务无关的自媚示例中学习到的向量来引导模型减少自媚，可以减少与知识警觉性相关的错误，使模型成为其证据更忠实的报告者，进而成为信息不对称合作任务中更可靠的伙伴。

articles.title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
articles.abstract: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.
articles.titleCn: 泄露它：一种从黑盒语言模型中提取训练数据的概率方法
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的成员推理（MIA）通常通过汇总的ROC-AUC进行总结，但此类评估存在混淆：无模型的盲基准仅凭表面文本就能区分成员与非成员。我们从概率学的角度研究黑盒、基于采样的训练数据泄露，将p(.|x)的N个样本视为输出分布的估计，并将泄露信号视为该分布的泛函。我们将盲基准的批判扩展到采样机制：在WikiMIA上，盲词袋分类器达到AUC 0.97（在5% FPR时TPR为0.90），而采样毫无增益；在IID Pile分割（MIMIR）中，自我集中或黄金延续恢复均未显著优于盲基准（增量AUC的95%置信区间包含零）。汇总指标掩盖了真实危害。相同的采样字面提取了盲攻击无法触及的文档尾部训练数据。在Pythia-6.9B中，500个Pile文档中有83个（占16.6%；占带电子邮件地址文档的21.3%）在错配前缀控制下既有确切标识符的重复也有不重复，因此每个泄露可归因于该文档，而非全局通用字符串。这种逐文档泄露对汇总AUC不可见，且随模型容量增长（从410M到6.9B，从5.6%增长到16.6%）。风险分布不均：标识符泄露在代码中约是散文的3倍，尽管散文仍显著为正且随容量增长（从4.0%到12.1%），而任意排除延续的恢复仅限于代码（GitHub上成员差距为+0.44，散文最多为+0.014）。温度和核采样影响甚微，16个词前缀已足够，且我们未发现语料库去重带来的减少。隐私审计应报告逐文档提取，按领域分解，而非单一AUC。我们发布了leakit，一个黑盒提取审计工具。

articles.title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
articles.abstract: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each from XSum, WritingPrompts, and OpenWebText) and four open-weight generators (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B). Each source item yields four matched variants: human-written (HUMAN), direct LLM generation (Free-LLM), LLM-rewritten human text (H2L), and same-generator LLM-rewritten LLM text (LLM2L). We evaluated five detectors (FastDetectGPT, Binoculars-falcon-7b, RADAR, BERT-Defense, RoBERTa-Defense) at a strict 1%-false-positive operating point (TPR@1%FPR). FastDetectGPT and Binoculars-falcon-7b detected 91.2% and 93.5\% of direct LLM text, but only 30.8% and 15.1% of human text an LLM had rewritten, a drop of 60-78 percentage points. The same detectors retained 78.3% and 83.0% recall when LLM text was rewritten by the same model, a much smaller decline of 10-13 points. RADAR followed the same pattern (66.8% to 12.2%), while BERT-Defense and RoBERTa-Defense stayed below 3% recall across all regimes. These results show that detector performance measured on the conventional human-vs-LLM benchmark does not transfer to human-authored text revised by an LLM, even though the same detectors remain largely robust to LLM-only rewriting.
articles.titleCn: ARB：用于AI文本检测器评估的作者署名-重写匹配基准数据集
articles.abstractCn: 标准AI文本检测基准将人类撰写的文本与大型语言模型（LLM）直接生成的文本进行比较。尽管先前研究表明重写和释义会降低检测器的性能，但尚不清楚在传统基准上测量的性能是否能够预测检测器在人类撰写的文本被LLM重写时的行为。为填补这一空白，我们引入了作者重写基准（ARB），该基准由1,800篇人类源文本（XSum、WritingPrompts和OpenWebText各600篇）以及四个开放权重生成器（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B）构建而成。每个源项产生四个匹配变体：人类撰写（HUMAN）、直接LLM生成（Free-LLM）、LLM重写的人类文本（H2L）以及相同生成器重写的LLM文本（LLM2L）。我们在严格的1%假阳性操作点（TPR@1%FPR）下评估了五种检测器（FastDetectGPT、Binoculars-falcon-7b、RADAR、BERT-Defense、RoBERTa-Defense）。FastDetectGPT和Binoculars-falcon-7b检测了91.2%和93.5%的直接LLM文本，但仅检测了30.8%和15.1%被LLM重写的人类文本，下降了60-78个百分点。当LLM文本被相同模型重写时，这两种检测器仍保持了78.3%和83.0%的召回率，下降幅度仅为10-13点。RADAR遵循相同模式（66.8%降至12.2%），而BERT-Defense和RoBERTa-Defense在所有情况下召回率均低于3%。这些结果表明，在传统人类与LLM基准上测量的检测器性能并不能迁移到被LLM修订的人类文本，尽管相同的检测器对仅由LLM进行的重写仍然具有较强鲁棒性。

articles.title: Evidence-Type Competition: When Can Interventional Data Teach Language Models Causal Direction?
articles.abstract: Interventional data is widely regarded as the gold standard for teaching models causal reasoning. We test this assumption in a fully controlled synthetic environment pitting observational correlation against causal effect, and find it fails instructively. In Simpson's-paradox worlds, where the two have systematically opposite signs, increasing the fraction of interventional samples in pretraining does not improve causal direction: the magnitude of the model's do()-response grows monotonically, yet its sign is copied from the observational context. What governs whether interventional evidence is used is not the training mixture but the evidence type present in the context at inference time. Under an identical training recipe, a purely observational context induces systematic sign reversal in 29/50 worlds, a mixed context in 19/50, while aligned interventional probes alone yield 41/50 correct. Erasing observational evidence from the context immediately releases the suppressed causal interpolation ability (ratio_true = +0.56); a four-state content manipulation shows the switch is content-mediated and graded. The suppression is stable across training seeds (11/11 strong reversals persist on a matched-protocol second seed) and robust as a rate at 0.93B parameters (31.8% vs. 6% reversals in the matched probe-only arm), even as absolute gains shrink four-fold. An external audit on CLadder exposes a learned positive-effect prior with a two-layer structure: sign-randomized retraining removes it in-distribution but not out-of-distribution. We summarize: the capability lives in the weights; the switch lives in the context, and activation patching localizes the switch to the middle layers' observational rows. We further quantify the sampling noise floor of probe-based causal evaluation and an evidence-averaging protocol that cuts sign errors from 26% to 9%.
articles.titleCn: 证据类型竞争：干预性数据何时能教会语言模型因果方向？
articles.abstractCn: 干预数据被广泛认为是教授模型因果推理的金标准。我们在一个完全受控的合成环境中测试了这一假设，该环境将观察相关性与因果效应进行对比，发现它具有误导性。在辛普森悖论世界中，当两者具有系统性地相反的符号时，增加预训练中干预样本的比例并不能改善因果方向：模型do()-响应的幅度单调增长，但其符号则复制自观察背景。决定是否使用干预证据的是推理时上下文中的证据类型，而非训练混合物。在相同的训练配方下，纯观察性上下文在50个世界中导致29个系统性符号反转，混合上下文导致19个，而仅对齐的干预探针正确率达41/50。从上下文中消除观察证据会立即释放被抑制的因果插值能力（ratio_true = +0.56）；一个四态内容操控实验表明，这种转换是内容介导且分级的。这种抑制在训练种子间是稳定的（11/11强反转在匹配协议的第二种子上持续存在），并且作为一个比率在0.93B参数时依然稳健（匹配探针仅臂中31.8%与6%的反转），即使绝对收益缩小四倍。对CLadder的外部审计揭示了一个具有双层结构的学到的正效应先验：符号随机重训练在分布内移除它，但在分布外无效。我们总结：能力存在于权重中；转换存在于上下文中，激活补丁将转换定位到中间层的观察行。我们进一步量化了基于探针的因果评估的采样噪声底线，以及一个将符号错误从26%削减到9%的证据平均协议。

articles.title: Know It, Act on It: Investigating Memory Utilization in LLM Personalization
articles.abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents evolve into personalized companions, memory has emerged as a core capability. However, LLMs face a knowledge utilization problem: they may fail to act on relevant user preferences even when they are fully present in context. When an agent fails to tailor its response in a context where previously shared user preferences should matter, it is unclear whether the model failed to remember that information or remembered it but failed to use it. To isolate this breakdown, we introduce a decoupled evaluation paradigm that administers paired Know and Act tests to the same user preference. We conduct large-scale experiments across 16 systems and five memory architectures, evaluating 1,000 preferences embedded at three levels of expression strength. Our results show a large gap between Know and Act outcomes: agents often pass the recall test for a user preference but fail to reflect that same preference in the paired behavioral scenario. While memory architectures reduce this gap, utilization remains especially weak for health and therapy-related preferences, where failures to act carry the greatest real-world stakes.
articles.titleCn: 了解它，采取行动：调查LLM个性化中的内存利用
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）代理演变为个性化伴侣，记忆已成为一项核心能力。然而，LLM面临知识利用问题：即使它们在上下文中完全存在，也可能无法根据相关的用户偏好采取行动。当代理在原本应考虑先前共享的用户偏好的上下文中未能调整其回应时，不清楚是模型未能记住这些信息，还是记住了但未能使用它们。为了隔离这种故障，我们引入了一种解耦评估范式，对同一用户偏好进行配对的“知道”和“行动”测试。我们在16个系统和五种记忆架构上进行了大规模实验，评估了1000个在不同表达强度级别嵌入的用户偏好。我们的结果表明，“知道”和“行动”结果之间存在巨大差距：代理通常能通过用户偏好的回忆测试，但在配对的行为场景中却未能体现同样的偏好。虽然记忆架构可以缩小这种差距，但在与健康和疗法相关的偏好上，利用仍然特别薄弱，而行动失败所带来的现实影响最为严重。

articles.title: A Fortran General-Purpose Transpiler: Proof of Concept
articles.abstract: Fortran has been the cornerstone of high-performance computing for decades and remains unmatched in many domains. Yet the language faces an expertise gap: a new generation of scientists is barely familiar with it, while many experienced Fortran developers are only now transitioning to modern ecosystems such as JAX. This gap often results in "Fython"--Python code written with a Fortran mindset-- that fails to leverage modern frameworks. We present FGPT, a Python-based compiler framework designed to bridge this divide. It provides a systematic pipeline that transpiles Fortran into GPU-adapted Fortran, auto-differentiable Fortran via Tapenade, or NumPy and JAX modules. Its architecture comprises three stages: (i) a frontend that parses Fortran and extracts target procedures along with their cross-module dependencies; (ii) a middle-end that lowers the code into an intermediate representation, then into GPU-adapted or auto-differentiable Fortran, or a NumPy class; and (iii) a backend that rewrites control-flow and expressions to produce JAX modules ready for GPU acceleration and automatic differentiation. While large language models hold promise for small snippets, they fail at the scale of community scientific codes--often spanning hundreds of thousands of lines--where consistent transformations, strict numerical fidelity, and validation against production tests are non-negotiable. FGPT addresses these challenges by preserving program semantics throughout the entire translation. We verified the framework on representative climate modeling kernels and demonstrated that it produces correct, differentiable Python implementations without requiring manual intervention. By combining rigorous compiler techniques with modern accelerator support, FGPT offers a scalable, trustworthy path for modernizing legacy Fortran code.
articles.titleCn: 一个Fortran通用代码转换器：概念验证
articles.abstractCn: Fortran作为高性能计算数十年的基石，在许多领域依然无出其右。然而该语言面临专业知识的断层：新一代科学家几乎不熟悉它，而许多经验丰富的Fortran开发者也正逐步转向JAX等现代生态系统。这种断层常常导致“Fython”——用Fortran思维编写的Python代码——无法利用现代框架。我们提出了FGPT，这是一个基于Python的编译器框架，旨在弥合这一鸿沟。它提供了一套系统化的流程，将Fortran转译为GPU适配的Fortran、通过Tapenade实现自动微分的Fortran，或NumPy和JAX模块。其架构包含三个阶段：（i）前端解析Fortran并提取目标过程及其跨模块依赖；（ii）中端将代码转换为中间表示，再转化为GPU适配的Fortran、自动微分的Fortran或NumPy类；（iii）后端重写控制流和表达式，生成适用于GPU加速和自动微分的JAX模块。虽然大型语言模型在小片段代码上前景可期，但在社区科学代码的规模上——通常跨越数十万行——一致性的转换、严格的数值保真度以及与生产测试的验证都不可或缺。FGPT通过在整个翻译过程中保留程序语义来解决这些挑战。我们在代表性的气候模型内核上验证了该框架，并证明它能够生成无需人工干预的正确、可微分的Python实现。通过结合严谨的编译器技术与现代加速器支持，FGPT为现代化遗留Fortran代码提供了可扩展、值得信赖的路径。

articles.title: Bridging the Question-Answer Gap in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Hypothetical Prompt Embeddings
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems synergize retrieval mechanisms with generative language models to enhance the accuracy and relevance of responses. However, bridging the style gap between user queries and relevant information in document text remains a persistent challenge in retrieval-augmented systems, often addressed by runtime solutions (e.g., Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE)) that attempt to improve alignment but introduce extra computational overhead at query time. To address these challenges, we propose Hypothetical Prompt Embeddings (HyPE), a framework that shifts the generation of hypothetical content from query time to the indexing phase. By precomputing multiple hypothetical prompts for each data chunk and embedding the chunk in place of the prompt, HyPE transforms retrieval into a question-question matching task, bypassing the need for runtime synthetic answer generation. This approach does not introduce latency but also strengthens the alignment between queries and relevant context. Our experimental results on six common datasets show that HyPE can improve retrieval context precision by up to 42 percentage points and claim recall by up to 45 percentage points, compared to standard approaches, while remaining compatible with re-ranking, multi-vector retrieval, query decomposition, and other RAG advancements
articles.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Published in IEEE Access
articles.titleCn: 在检索增强生成中弥合问答差距：假设性提示嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过结合检索机制与生成式语言模型来提升响应的准确性和相关性。然而，在检索增强系统中，弥合用户查询与文档文本中相关信息的风格差距仍然是一个持续存在的挑战，通常通过运行时解决方案（例如假设文档嵌入（HyDE））来处理，这些方案试图改善对齐但会在查询时引入额外的计算开销。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了假设性提示嵌入（HyPE）框架，该框架将假设内容的生成从查询阶段转移到索引阶段。通过预先为每个数据块计算多个假设性提示，并将数据块嵌入到提示的位置，HyPE将检索转变为问题-问题匹配任务，从而避免了运行时合成答案生成的需求。这种方法不仅不引入延迟，还加强了查询与相关上下文之间的对齐。我们在六个常见数据集上的实验结果表明，与标准方法相比，HyPE可以将检索上下文精确度提高高达42个百分点，将主张召回率提高高达45个百分点，同时仍与重排序、多向量检索、查询分解等其他RAG进展保持兼容。

articles.title: Studying quantization trade-offs for efficient inference deployment in machine translation
articles.abstract: Deploying large language models in realistic server environments poses challenges, as the system needs to provide high-quality responses with low latency. Quantization is a common approach to reduce the memory footprint and improve inference efficiency, yet its impact on latency and throughput is rarely evaluated under controlled, orchestration-level workloads. In this work we study the quantization trade-offs of two translation model families, EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} and Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy} across five models ranging from 1.7B to 22B for efficient deployment on a single A100 or H100 GPU. We demonstrate that combining a document-chunking strategy with W4A8 or W8A8 quantization improves the latency-throughput Pareto-curve under a wide range of workloads. Furthermore, since standard machine translation (MT) benchmarks rely on isolated sentences and fail to capture long-context dynamics, we introduce a document-level evaluation from WMT24++ to assess how text chunking strategies affect translation quality under quantization. Our results reveal that standard segment-level evaluation can fail to predict the interaction between quantization and long-context document translation. While Hy-MT2 remains robust under quantization, EuroLLM shows strong sensitivity and translation quality collapses rapidly for all considered quantization formats. Overall, our experiments show that the trade-off between inference efficiency and translation quality depends not only on the quantization format, but also on the choice of text chunking strategy.
articles.titleCn: 研究机器翻译中高效推理部署的量化权衡
articles.abstractCn: 在真实服务器环境中部署大型语言模型面临挑战，因为系统需要在低延迟下提供高质量的响应。量化是一种常见的减少内存占用和提高推理效率的方法，但其在受控的、编排级工作负载下的延迟和吞吐量影响很少被评估。在这项工作中，我们研究了两个翻译模型家族 EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} 和 Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy} 在五个模型（从 1.7B 到 22B）上的量化权衡，以实现在单个 A100 或 H100 GPU 上的高效部署。我们证明，结合文档分块策略与 W4A8 或 W8A8 量化，可以在广泛的负载范围内改善延迟-吞吐量帕累托曲线。此外，由于标准机器翻译（MT）基准依赖于孤立的句子且无法捕捉长上下文动态，我们从 WMT24++ 引入文档级评估，以评估文本分块策略在量化下如何影响翻译质量。我们的结果表明，标准的分段级评估可能无法预测量化与长上下文文档翻译之间的相互作用。虽然 Hy-MT2 在量化下依然稳健，但 EuroLLM 表现出强烈的敏感性，并且在所有考虑的量化格式下翻译质量迅速崩溃。总体而言，我们的实验表明，推理效率与翻译质量之间的权衡不仅取决于量化格式，还取决于文本分块策略的选择。

articles.title: PTP: Previous-Token Prediction based LLM Inversion for Near-Exact Prompt Reconstruction
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate text by auto-regressively sampling the next token. This inherently leads to a many-to-many mapping between prompts and responses, complicating the task of inferring prompts from observed outputs. Prior work on LLM inversion frames prompt recovery as a semantic reconstruction task. They rely on fine-tuning pretrained sequence-to-sequence models on large external datasets--and requiring access to model weights or logits--to generate semantically plausible prompts. In contrast, we present a functional approach to inverting a given LLM in a black-box setting, without auxiliary aids. We train an explicit inverse language model entirely from scratch on data synthetically generated from the target LLM itself. Analogous to forward next-token prediction, our inverse model is trained using previous-token prediction, establishing a generative link between the forward and inverse processes that enables faithful prompt reconstruction. Moreover, it naturally supports diverse prompt reconstructions through sampling, whereby all such prompts induce similar responses under the forward, target LLM. Our approach generalises across datasets and exhibits transferability in reconstructing prompts from responses generated by different LLMs. Further, across the set of token based evaluation metrics for prompt and response reconstructions, our approach outperforms prior work.
articles.titleCn: 基于先前标记预测的LLM反转用于近似精确提示重建
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过自回归采样下一个词元来生成文本。这本质上导致提示与响应之间存在多对多的映射关系，从而增加了从观察到的输出中推断提示的任务难度。先前关于LLM反演的研究将提示恢复视为语义重建任务。它们依赖于在大型外部数据集上微调预训练的序列到序列模型——并需要访问模型权重或logits——以生成语义上合理的提示。相比之下，我们提出了一种在黑盒设置下反演给定LLM的功能性方法，无需辅助工具。我们在从目标LLM本身合成生成的数据上完全从头开始训练一个显式的反向语言模型。类似于正向下一个词元预测，我们的反向模型通过使用先前词元预测进行训练，在正向和反向过程之间建立了生成性联系，从而能够忠实地重建提示。此外，它通过采样自然地支持多样化的提示重建，其中所有此类提示在正向目标LLM下会诱导相似的响应。我们的方法可以泛化到不同数据集，并在从不同LLM生成的响应中重建提示方面表现出可迁移性。此外，在提示和响应重建的基于词元的评估指标集合中，我们的方法优于先前的工作。

articles.title: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: LLM agents need memory to act consistently over long interactions, yet many systems use additional LLM calls to operate that memory. Generating intermediate records and mediating their retrieval adds recurring token and time costs, while omitted or merged details can obscure the original evidence. We ask whether structured memory access requires generation at all. Zero-Mem introduces \emph{zero-token memory operations}: no step outside final question answering invokes an LLM or consumes LLM input or output tokens; encoder computation is accounted for separately. Zero-Mem preserves original interaction traces as its source of record. It organizes the traces in two complementary ways. An entity--context graph exposes connections across interactions, while a temporal hierarchy preserves conversational locality and session state. For each query, Zero-Mem weighs the two views, retrieves from both, and follows their structure to recover supporting relations or surrounding context. Deterministic calibration first discards conflicting evidence and then keeps the reader's answer grounded in the retrieved traces. Only the final-QA reader invokes an LLM. Across long-memory and long-context question-answering benchmarks, Zero-Mem achieves competitive performance while eliminating LLM calls and LLM-token consumption from memory operations. With the same final-QA reader and context budget, it reduces memory-operation time cost by 57.6\% relative to the fastest compared baseline. Ablations support the contribution of the two views and their query-dependent coordination. Overall, the results show that structured agent memory need not generate an intermediate representation of the past. After peer review, the code and implementation details will be available at \textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/TheMoon0815/Zero-mem}.
articles.titleCn: 零内存：面向大型语言模型代理的零标记内存操作
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理需要记忆以在长时间交互中保持一致性，但许多系统使用额外的LLM调用来操作该记忆。生成中间记录和调解其检索会增加反复的token和时间成本，而遗漏或合并的细节可能会掩盖原始证据。我们提出是否结构化记忆访问真的需要生成。Zero-Mem引入了\emph{零token记忆操作}：除了最终问题回答之外，没有步骤会调用LLM或消耗LLM输入或输出token；编码器计算单独计算。Zero-Mem将原始交互记录保留为其记录来源。它以两种互补的方式组织这些记录。实体-上下文图展示了跨交互的连接，而时间层次结构保留了对话局部性和会话状态。对于每个查询，Zero-Mem权衡这两种视图，从两者中检索，并遵循其结构来恢复支持关系或周围上下文。确定性校准首先丢弃冲突证据，然后将读者的回答与检索到的记录相结合。只有最终-QA读者会调用LLM。在长记忆和长上下文问答基准测试中，Zero-Mem实现了具有竞争力的性能，同时消除了记忆操作中的LLM调用和LLM-token消耗。使用相同的最终-QA读者和上下文预算，它将记忆操作时间成本相对于最快的基线降低了57.6%。消融实验支持两种视图及其查询相关协调的贡献。总体而言，结果表明结构化代理记忆不需要生成过去的中间表示。同行评审后，代码和实现细节将在\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/TheMoon0815/Zero-mem}提供。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Transfer for Machine Translation in Turkic Languages
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual transfer is central to low-resource machine translation, but its behavior within closely related language families remains insufficiently characterized. We study transfer among five Turkic languages; Turkish, Azerbaijani, Uzbek, Kazakh, and Kyrgyz; using pairwise transfer matrices. In this setting, each model is fine-tuned with one transfer source and evaluated on a different transfer target while the translation target remains the same. Across mT5 experiments, we find that transfer is strongest between closely related Turkic pairs, especially Turkish-Azerbaijani and Kazakh-Kyrgyz. We also show that transfer direction matters, and that the same transfer source-transfer target pair can behave differently when the translation target changes. Latinization improves BLEU and chrF in several script-mismatched settings, but its effect is not uniform across metrics. Additional analyses show that transfer sources are mostly stable across different datasets and model settings.
articles.titleCn: 突厥语系机器翻译中的跨语言迁移
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言迁移是低资源机器翻译的核心，但其在密切相关的语言家族中的表现尚未得到充分描述。我们研究了五种突厥语——土耳其语、阿塞拜疆语、乌兹别克语、哈萨克语和吉尔吉斯语——之间的迁移，使用成对迁移矩阵。在这种设置下，每个模型使用一个迁移源进行微调，并在不同的迁移目标上进行评估，而翻译目标保持不变。在mT5实验中，我们发现迁移在密切相关的突厥语对之间最强，尤其是土耳其-阿塞拜疆和哈萨克-吉尔吉斯。我们还表明迁移方向很重要，相同的迁移源-迁移目标对在翻译目标变化时可能表现出不同的行为。拉丁化在某些书写不匹配的设置中提高了BLEU和chrF，但其效果在不同指标上并不一致。额外的分析表明，迁移源在不同数据集和模型设置中大多是稳定的。

articles.title: LLM-OSDA: An Optimal-Stopping Dynamic Auction for Native Advertising in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
articles.abstract: LLM-native advertising embeds sponsored content directly into model-generated responses, shifting the unit of sale from a fixed slot to a moment within an evolving conversation. Existing LLM ad-auction mechanisms primarily operate within a single response, settling the winner but not the timing. The extension is nontrivial: with one native insertion opportunity per session, the stopping time depends on bids, coupling timing with allocation, so static truthfulness arguments no longer apply. We propose the LLM-based Optimal Stopping Dynamic Auction (LLM-OSDA), a dynamic cost-per-click auction that integrates Bellman optimal stopping, winner allocation, and envelope pricing. A bid-independent LLM layer estimates contextual click quality and seamlessly renders the winning ad, while bids enter only the committed auction mechanism. Under an exact Bellman oracle, the expected discounted-click allocation is monotone in each advertiser's bid, and the corresponding envelope payment makes truthful bidding weakly dominant in expectation. For practical deployment, a learned StopNet approximates the Bellman action values. We show that its decisions differ from the optimal policy only near the stopping boundary and bound the resulting incentive loss in terms of its approximation error. Experiments on a simulated conversational advertising corpus show that LLM-OSDA improves net revenue by 11 percent over the strongest fixed-timing baseline while maintaining comparable user retention. Code is at https://github.com/2025Fang2025/llm-osda.
articles.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
articles.titleCn: LLM-OSDA：多轮LLM对话中用于原生广告的最优停止动态拍卖
articles.abstractCn: LLM原生广告将赞助内容直接嵌入模型生成的响应中，将销售单位从固定位置转变为不断发展的对话中的某个时刻。现有的LLM广告拍卖机制主要在单个响应内运行，确定获胜者但未确定时间。扩展并非易事：每场对话只有一个原生插入机会，停止时间取决于出价，将时间与分配耦合，因此静态真实性论点不再适用。我们提出了基于LLM的最优停止动态拍卖（LLM-OSDA），这是一种动态每次点击成本拍卖，集成了贝尔曼最优停止、获胜者分配和信封定价。一个与出价无关的LLM层估计上下文点击质量，并无缝渲染获胜广告，而出价仅进入承诺的拍卖机制。在精确的贝尔曼预言机下，预期折现点击分配在每位广告商的出价中是单调的，相应的信封支付使得真实出价在期望中具有弱占优性。对于实际部署，一个学习的StopNet近似贝尔曼行动值。我们表明其决策仅在停止边界附近与最优策略不同，并对其产生的激励损失以近似误差进行界限。在模拟对话广告语料库上的实验表明，LLM-OSDA比最强的固定时间基线提高了11%的净收入，同时保持了相当的用户留存。代码位于https://github.com/2025Fang2025/llm-osda。

articles.title: Translation with Thought: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Multi-domain machine translation (MDMT) poses a unique challenge due to varying levels of linguistic complexity across domains. Inspired by human translators' ability to adapt reasoning effort based on difficulty, we propose TwT (Translation with Thought), a resource-rational framework that learns to modulate inference between intuitive and deliberate reasoning. TwT is trained in two stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning on difficulty-aware long chain-of-thought traces distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and rewritten by GPT-4o to reflect human-like reasoning economy, and (2) reinforcement learning with a hybrid reward to optimize translation quality and reasoning efficiency. Evaluated on 15 benchmarks spanning in-domain and out-of-domain settings, as well as 3 seen and 59 unseen languages, with ablations across three backbone models, TwT-7B and TwT-14B outperform much larger SOTA reasoning models in translation quality, while reducing token usage by 32--60\%. These results confirm that aligning translation behavior with cognitive principles enables robust generalization, high translation quality, and efficient reasoning in MDMT.
articles.comment: 34 pages, 17 figures, and 21 tables. Accepted to ACL 2026
articles.titleCn: 带思考的翻译：基于强化学习的多领域机器翻译难度自适应推理
articles.abstractCn: 多领域机器翻译（MDMT）由于不同领域间语言复杂度的差异而面临独特挑战。受人类译者根据难度调整推理投入的能力启发，我们提出了TwT（带思考的翻译）框架，这是一个资源合理化的框架，能够学习在直觉推理和刻意推理之间调节推理过程。TwT分两个阶段进行训练：（1）在由DeepSeek-R1提取并经GPT-4o改写以反映类似人类推理经济性的难度感知长链式思维轨迹上进行监督微调；（2）采用混合奖励的强化学习来优化翻译质量和推理效率。在涵盖领域内和领域外环境、涉及3种已知和59种未知语言的15个基准测试中，跨三种主干模型进行消融实验，TwT-7B和TwT-14B在翻译质量上优于远超其规模的SOTA推理模型，同时将token使用量减少32%至60%。这些结果证实，将翻译行为与认知原理相结合，能够在MDMT中实现稳健泛化、高翻译质量及高效推理。

articles.title: Language Models Agree With Each Other, Not With Readers
articles.abstract: Claims that language models homogenise are usually measured against human judgements collected for the study, which makes the human side an artifact of the design: a crowdworker given the model's instruction is running the model's prompt. We measure convergence against a human reference nobody built for the purpose -- 2,523 reader mark sets across 120 web documents, produced by people highlighting for their own reasons on a platform where the overlay of others' marks is off by default. Agreement is the overlap between two size-matched sentence sets minus the overlap expected when each is resampled within its own depth-and-length bands. The null's calibration is demonstrated, not asserted: every pair involving a random baseline lands within 0.006 of zero. On the median document each party names 14 sentences of 70; two readers share 4.1 and two models 8.7. Across 18 model arms spanning 11 vendors, 3 countries and both weight regimes, the median of 153 model pairs is +0.093 against a human yardstick of +0.040, and 99 sit entirely above the human interval. Two frontier models from rival labs reach +0.203, twice what GPT-4o agrees with itself on a second call. The effect is not determinism, prompt wording, procedure, vendor or routing, and it is graded: the smallest models agree at the human level. No model agrees with readers detectably more than a reader does, and at equal depth and length no surface feature separates their choices. The multiples are procedure-dependent and the ordering is not: models are cut to their sharpest set while a reader's is a random draw from what they marked, and blunting the models alike halves the gap without closing it. Tested out of sample on four models released after this analysis, against predictions fixed beforehand, none clears the human interval. A population simulated from several models is not several populations.
articles.comment: 18 pages. Ancillary files include all three pre-registrations, every analysis script and every result artifact; the paper contains no numeric literal for a measured value and make-numbers.py regenerates all of them from the shipped artifacts alone
articles.titleCn: 语言模型彼此之间达成共识，而非与读者达成共识。
articles.abstractCn: 认为语言模型同质化的说法通常以研究收集的人类判断作为衡量标准，这使得人类因素成为设计中的一个产物：被赋予模型指令的众包工作者实际上是在运行模型的提示。我们衡量的是与一个非为该目的而构建的人类参考标准——2,523组读者标记集，跨越120篇网络文档，由人们在默认情况下关闭他人标记叠加的平台上进行标记而产生的——的收敛性。一致性是指两个大小匹配的句子集之间的重叠减去当每个句子集在其深度和长度范围内重新采样时预期的重叠。零假设的校准是证明而非断言：涉及随机基线的每一对结果都在0.006的零值附近。在每篇文档中，每一方标记了70个句子中的14个；两位读者共享4.1个，两位模型共享8.7个。在跨越11家供应商、3个国家以及两种权重制度的18个模型分支中，153对模型中位数为+0.093，相对于人类基准的+0.040，其中99对完全高于人类区间。来自竞争对手实验室的两款前沿模型达到了+0.203，是GPT-4o在第二次调用时自我同意的两倍。这种效应并非由确定性、提示措辞、程序、供应商或路由决定，而是有等级之分：最小的模型在人类水平上达成一致。没有模型与读者的同意程度明显超过读者自身的同意程度，且在相同深度和长度下，没有表面特征能区分他们的选择。倍数取决于程序，而顺序则不然：模型被裁剪到最锐利的集合，而读者的选择则是从他们标记的内容中随机抽取的，同等削弱模型会缩小差距而不消除它。在分析之后发布的四款模型上进行的样本外测试，针对事先固定的预测，没有一款能通过人类区间。从多个模型模拟出的种群并非多个种群。

articles.title: CalibratedRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubric Banks for Open-Ended LLM Evaluation
articles.abstract: Reliable evaluation of open-ended LLM outputs requires fine-grained rubrics, yet expert curation is costly and difficult to scale. Existing automated pipelines rely on strict judge unanimity and binary variance filters, which cannot distinguish measurable rubrics from informative ones. We introduce CalibratedRubric, a task-adaptive framework that combines type-specific scoring, Bayesian rubric-measurability filtering, and item response theory (IRT)-based bank assembly. CalibratedRubric estimates each rubric's measurability with a Beta--Bernoulli agreement posterior and uses a submodular information-coverage objective to construct compact rubric banks over the observed capability range. Across financial, healthcare, general, and legal benchmarks, measurability filtering improves human-gold agreement on JudgmentBench from $κ=0.604$ to $0.743$. IRT-based greedy selection improves cross-fitted rank fidelity over random selection across all six evaluated response blocks and requires only 49 rather than 131 rubrics to reach the target correlation on FinResearchBench decision-support tasks. Task-label perturbations further reduce system separation, confirming the practical relevance of task-adaptive scoring. These results support CalibratedRubric as an efficient, uncertainty-aware approach to open-ended LLM evaluation, with calibration gains depending on sufficient judge redundancy.
articles.titleCn: 校准评分标准：面向开放式大语言模型评估的任务自适应评分标准库
articles.abstractCn: 可靠的开放式大语言模型（LLM）输出评估需要细粒度的评分标准，但专家审核成本高昂且难以扩展。现有的自动化流程依赖于严格的裁判一致性和二元差异过滤，无法区分可测量的评分标准与信息性评分标准。我们引入了CalibratedRubric，这是一个任务自适应框架，结合了类型特定评分、贝叶斯评分标准可测量性过滤和基于项目反应理论（IRT）的评分标准库构建。CalibratedRubric使用Beta-Bernoulli一致性后验估计每个评分标准的可测量性，并使用子模态信息覆盖率目标在观察到的能力范围内构建紧凑的评分标准库。在金融、医疗、通用和法律基准测试中，可测量性过滤将JudgmentBench上的人类-黄金一致性从κ=0.604提高到0.743。基于IRT的贪婪选择在所有六个评估响应块中提高了交叉拟合的排名保真度，并且只需要49个而不是131个评分标准即可在FinResearchBench决策支持任务上达到目标相关性。任务标签扰动进一步降低了系统分离度，证实了任务自适应评分的实际意义。这些结果支持CalibratedRubric作为开放式LLM评估的高效、不确定性感知方法，其校准收益取决于足够的裁判冗余。

articles.title: Data Turnstile: A Scalable Open Framework for Function-Calling Data Generation
articles.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive for agentic deployment due to low latency, reduced cost, and on-device privacy, yet they struggle with tool-use tasks where training data is scarce and noisy. Unlike larger models, SLMs cannot compensate for low-quality supervision through sheer capacity, making data quality the critical bottleneck. We present Data Turnstile, an open-source framework that takes user-defined API specifications and generates high-quality synthetic training data for function calling. Turnstile decomposes multi-turn tool-use interactions into constrained, stepwise generation with validation and error-feedback loops, providing fine-grained control over API diversity, conversation complexity, and output correctness. We demonstrate effectiveness of domain adaptation with Turnstile data on two challenging function calling benchmarks.
