On the BFCL single-turn benchmark, a Qwen3-0.6B fine-tuned on Turnstile data without chain-of-thought achieves 75.9% overall accuracy (versus 67.4% for the base model with thinking enabled), closing the gap with thinking-enabled Qwen3-1.7B (78.4%) and Qwen3-4B (79.9%) despite being 3$\times$ and 7$\times$ smaller respectively. On $τ^2$-bench, a multi-turn agentic benchmark, Turnstile-trained Qwen3-1.7B achieves 31.1% pass^1 on the Telecom domain, improving 4.7$\times$ over its 6.6% base and surpassing Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (27.4%), a model 19$\times$ larger. Turnstile-trained Qwen3-0.6B achieves 24.6%, improving 7$\times$ over its 3.5% base and approaching the 32B model (53$\times$ larger). We release Data Turnstile along with a dataset spanning 1,000+ APIs and 100K+ multi-turn interactions.
articles.titleCn: 数据旋转门：一个可扩展的开放框架，用于函数调用数据生成
articles.abstractCn: 小型语言模型（SLMs）因其低延迟、成本降低和设备端隐私保护等特点，在代理部署方面具有吸引力，但在训练数据稀缺且嘈杂的工具使用任务中面临挑战。与大型模型不同，SLMs无法通过单纯增加容量来弥补低质量监督的不足，使得数据质量成为关键瓶颈。我们提出了Data Turnstile，一个开源框架，它接受用户定义的API规范并生成高质量的功能调用合成训练数据。Turnstile将多轮工具使用交互分解为带验证和错误反馈循环的约束化、逐步生成过程，从而对API多样性、对话复杂性和输出正确性进行细粒度控制。我们在两个具有挑战性的功能调用基准测试中展示了Turnstile数据的领域自适应效果。在BFCL单轮基准测试中，在Turnstile数据上微调的Qwen3-0.6B（未启用思维链）实现了75.9%的整体准确率（而启用思维链的基础模型为67.4%），尽管其大小分别是Qwen3-1.7B（3倍）和Qwen3-4B（7倍）的1/3和1/7，但仍缩小了与启用思维链的Qwen3-1.7B（78.4%）和Qwen3-4B（79.9%）之间的差距。在τ^2-bench（一个多轮代理基准测试）中，Turnstile训练的Qwen3-1.7B在电信领域实现了31.1%的通过率，比其6.6%的基础模型提升了4.7倍，并超过了Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct（27.4%），后者是一个19倍大的模型。Turnstile训练的Qwen3-0.6B实现了24.6%，比其3.5%的基础模型提升了7倍，并接近32B模型（53倍大）。我们发布了Data Turnstile，以及一个涵盖1000多个API和10万多个多轮交互的数据集。

articles.title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
articles.abstract: Optimizing modern recommender models still depends heavily on engineers manually iterating over architectural, objective, and training-strategy changes. While LLM-based agents can automate this trial-and-error process, allowing the LLM to both select modification directions and generate concrete hypotheses often leads to unstable search under limited experiment budgets. Inspired by the above challenge, we propose RecHarness, a Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for automated recommender model optimization. RecHarness separates the optimization process into two steps: a bandit router selects the next modification direction according to historical validation feedback, while the LLM generates a concrete optimization hypothesis and executable code edit within the selected direction. To sustain long-horizon exploration, RecHarness uses a jump-basin mechanism to activate a structural-jump arm when local edits stagnate. Across multiple recommendation tasks, datasets, and model backbones, RecHarness achieves more stable performance improvements and uses limited trial budgets more effectively than LLM-reasoning search. During a 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale short-video advertising platform, the selected candidate improves ADVV by 2.084%, Revenue by 0.534%, and Exposure by 0.559%. Code is available at https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness.
articles.titleCn: RecHarness：一种用于自进化推荐系统的 bandit 路由智能代理框架
articles.abstractCn: 优化现代推荐模型仍然高度依赖工程师手动迭代架构、目标函数和训练策略的变化。虽然基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体可以自动化这一试错过程，但让LLM既选择修改方向又生成具体假设，往往在有限的实验预算下导致搜索不稳定。受上述挑战的启发，我们提出了RecHarness，一个基于 bandit 路由的智能体框架，用于自动化推荐模型优化。RecHarness 将优化过程分为两个步骤：bandit 路由器根据历史验证反馈选择下一个修改方向，而 LLM 在选定方向内生成具体的优化假设和可执行代码编辑。为支持长期探索，RecHarness 使用跳跃盆地机制，在局部编辑停滞时激活结构跳跃臂。在多个推荐任务、数据集和模型主干上，RecHarness 比基于LLM推理的搜索实现了更稳定的性能提升，并更有效地利用有限的试错预算。在一个大型短视频广告平台进行的为期7天的在线 A/B 测试中，选定的候选方案将 ADVV 提升了 2.084%，收入提升了 0.534%，曝光提升了 0.559%。代码可在 https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness 获取。

articles.title: Small Is Enough: Per-User Style Rewriting of AI-Edited Text via LoRA Adapters
articles.abstract: InMyStyle is a privacy first, single user system that adapts small language models to rewrite AI-edited text towards an individual user's writing style without an instruction prompt at inference. Given a user's documents, it uses multiple local helper LLMs to construct paired training examples and fine tunes LoRA adapters on base models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters. Length aware generation budgets and automatic chunking support inputs of different lengths. On 219 evaluation pairs from a scientific-paper corpus, the automatic composite score plateaus at 0.69 [scale 0-1] across all model sizes under both greedy and sampled decoding. This observed plateau suggests that small models are sufficient for the measured rewriting task, with model size determining trade-offs rather than a stable quality ranking. As a secondary evaluation, 400 ratings from five LLM judges give InMyStyle outputs a mean perceived AI-ness score over 20% lower than their helper-AI generated inputs, while mean perceived AI-ness scores decrease with model size within InMyStyle.
articles.titleCn: 小即是美：通过LoRA适配器实现AI编辑文本的用户样式重写
articles.abstractCn: InMyStyle是一款以隐私为先的单用户系统，它能够自适应地调整小型语言模型，在不使用指令提示的情况下，将AI编辑的文本改写成符合个人用户写作风格的文本。该系统根据用户的文档，利用多个本地辅助大型语言模型构建成对训练样本，并在参数量从0.5B到7B的基础模型上微调LoRA适配器。长度感知生成预算和自动分块功能支持不同长度的输入。在从科学论文语料库中选取的219个评估对中，无论是贪婪解码还是采样解码，所有模型尺寸下的自动综合评分都稳定在0.69（评分范围0-1）。这一观察到的平台期表明，对于所测量的重写任务，小型模型就足够了，模型尺寸决定了权衡而非稳定的质量排名。作为次要评估，来自五个大型语言模型评委的400个评分显示，InMyStyle的输出在感知AI程度评分上比其辅助AI生成的输入平均降低了20%以上，而在InMyStyle中，感知AI程度评分随着模型尺寸的增加而降低。

articles.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this \textit{futile reasoning} phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle errors, escalating with task difficulty. To address this, we introduce \textbf{CaRL} (\textbf{Ca}pability-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning), which aligns model behavior with capability boundaries through reward shaping that incentivizes refusal over futile reasoning and hindsight refusal augmentation that converts failures into refusal supervision. Experiments demonstrate a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties, effectively achieving capability-aligned behavior without sacrificing utility. \footnote{https://github.com/icip-cas/Knowing-When-to-Quit}
articles.titleCn: 知道何时放弃：诊断和训练大型语言模型以中止徒劳的推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在超出其能力范围的任务上生成计算成本高昂且语义空洞的推理，从而在看似合理但错误的推演误导用户时造成风险。通过系统性分析，我们刻画了这种\textit{徒劳推理}现象，揭示了普遍的能力过度和能力和行为之间系统性的误校准问题。主要的失效模式是虚假推理，其输出看似有效但包含细微错误，并随着任务难度升级。为解决这一问题，我们引入了\textbf{CaRL}（\textbf{Ca}pability-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning），通过奖励塑形将模型行为与能力边界对齐，奖励塑形激励拒绝徒劳推理，并通过后见之明拒绝增强将失败转化为拒绝监督。实验证明，在保持不同任务难度下性能的同时，显著减少了徒劳推理，有效实现了与能力对齐的行为，而未牺牲实用性。\footnote{https://github.com/icip-cas/Knowing-When-to-Quit}

articles.title: Hy-MultiTurn: A Six-Dimensional Benchmark for Deep Multi-Turn Dialogue Understanding
articles.abstract: Long-running multi-turn interactions with chatbots and agents are now common, and a correct response often depends on remembering earlier details, tracking later revisions, identifying intended objects or referents, and withholding action when required conditions are unmet. Existing multi-turn benchmarks typically cover short exchanges and do not fully evaluate these capabilities in long multi-turn interactions, particularly in Chinese, while offering limited insight into how and why models fail. To address these limitations, we analyze real chatbot failures to identify six recurring mechanisms and use them to define six controlled evaluation modes in Hy-MultiTurn, a Chinese benchmark for deep multi-turn dialogue understanding. The six modes evaluate constraint memory, precise execution, constraint synthesis, object localization, action suppression, and reference resolution. Across the six modes, we construct 209 controlled tasks spanning 12-76 turns, with dialogue length, irrelevant-topic distraction, and colloquial phrasing adding further difficulty. Evaluation of 22 frontier model configurations shows that Hy-MultiTurn is broadly challenging, as even GPT-5.5, the strongest overall configuration, satisfies all requirements in only 41.1 percent of responses and no model performs best in all six modes.
articles.titleCn: Hy-MultiTurn：一个用于深度多轮对话理解的六维基准
articles.abstractCn: 当前，与聊天机器人和智能体进行长时间的多轮交互已十分普遍，而正确的回复往往需要记住早期的细节、追踪后续的修订、识别意图对象或指代，并在所需条件未满足时抑制行动。现有的多轮基准测试通常涵盖简短的交流，并未全面评估长时间多轮交互中的这些能力，尤其是在中文方面，同时也未能提供关于模型失败原因和方式的深入见解。为解决这些局限性，我们分析了真实的聊天机器人失败案例，以识别六个反复出现的机制，并利用这些机制在中文深度多轮对话理解基准测试Hy-MultiTurn中定义了六个受控评估模式。这六个模式评估约束记忆、精确执行、约束合成、对象定位、行动抑制和指代消解。在六个模式中，我们构建了209个受控任务，涵盖12至76轮对话，对话长度、无关主题干扰和口语化表达进一步增加了难度。对22个前沿模型配置的评估表明，Hy-MultiTurn具有广泛的挑战性，即使是最强的整体配置GPT-5.5，在仅41.1%的回复中满足所有要求，且没有模型在所有六个模式中表现最佳。

articles.title: Detecting Experiential Intertextuality Across Migration Routes: Beyond Surface Similarity in French Narratives

authors.name: Said Jabbour
authors.affiliation: 27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue

articles.abstract: Migrants traversing geographically distinct routes such as the Trans-Saharan and Balkan corridors often recount strikingly parallel lived experiences: police violence, smuggler exploitation, dangerous crossings, and family separation. We introduce the task of experiential intertextuality detection: automatically identifying shared experiential echoes across migration narratives without requiring annotated training data. From 108 French migration narratives spanning both corridors, we automatically generate sentence pairs and score them using annotation-free methods: lexical baselines, sentence embeddings, POS-based structural features, a migration-specific theme lexicon, context-aware narrative features, and zero-shot LLM scoring with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B under three prompting strategies. We validate all methods against 816 expert-annotated intertextuality judgments (inter-annotator Krippendorff's $α= 0.27$). Our results reveal that all surface, structural, and embedding methods correlate only weakly with expert judgments ($r \leq 0.30$); Qwen2.5-7B zero-shot achieves the best single-method correlation ($r = 0.38$); few-shot examples degrade Qwen but dramatically improve Mistral; narrative position significantly predicts intertextuality, with departure-phase pairs showing the highest experiential echoes; and a supervised hybrid combining all 31 features achieves $r = 0.45$, a 21% improvement over the best individual method.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SIGDIAL 2026 (27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue)
articles.titleCn: 跨迁移路线的体验互文性检测：超越法语叙事的表面相似性
articles.abstractCn: 穿越撒哈拉走廊和巴尔干走廊等地理差异显著的移民路线时，他们往往描述了惊人相似的亲身经历：警察暴力、走私者剥削、危险穿越以及家庭分离。我们提出了体验互文性检测任务：在不依赖标注训练数据的情况下，自动识别移民叙述中共享的体验回响。从涵盖这两个走廊的108份法语移民叙述中，我们自动生成句子对，并使用无标注方法进行评分：词汇基线、句子嵌入、基于词性标注的结构特征、特定于移民的主题词汇、情境感知叙事特征，以及使用Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B在三种提示策略下的零样本LLM评分。我们用816份专家标注的互文性判断（标注者间Krippendorff's α=0.27）对所有方法进行验证。结果表明，所有表面、结构和嵌入方法与专家判断的相关性均较弱（r≤0.30）；Qwen2.5-7B零样本实现了最佳单方法相关性（r=0.38）；少量样本示例降低了Qwen的性能，但显著提升了Mistral；叙事位置显著预测了互文性，出发阶段句子对显示出最高的体验回响；结合所有31个特征的监督混合方法实现了r=0.45，比最佳单方法提高了21%。

articles.title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
articles.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models with human preferences via reinforcement learning. Although traditional scalar RMs enable efficient and probabilistic reward modeling, they rely on superficial cues that fail to generalize to complex or out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. Conversely, generative RMs leverage extensive reasoning to improve robustness on challenging tasks, but their natural language-based scores lack the numerical flexibility and probabilistic interpretability that scalar RMs offer. While recent approaches combine both paradigms through off-policy multi-task learning, such parallel optimization does not guarantee that generated reasoning traces actively align with or benefit downstream scalar reward prediction. To address this mismatch, we propose LatentRM, a reward modeling framework that learns intermediate reasoning traces as discrete latent variables to explicitly maximize the likelihood of downstream scalar rewards. Through on-policy optimization of the latent reasoning space end-to-end, LatentRM tightly couples deep reasoning-based evaluation with precise scoring. Extensive validations on in-distribution and OOD datasets and RLHF show that LatentRM outperforms scalar, generative, and hybrid RMs on preference modeling and policy alignment across tasks ranging from open-ended conversation to complex reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 端到端学习标量奖励模型中的潜在推理轨迹
articles.abstractCn: 奖励模型（RMs）在通过强化学习将大型语言模型与人类偏好对齐方面至关重要。尽管传统的标量RM能够实现高效且概率化的奖励建模，但它们依赖于表面线索，这些线索无法泛化到复杂或分布外（OOD）任务。相反，生成式RM利用广泛的推理来提高在挑战性任务上的鲁棒性，但它们基于自然语言的评分缺乏标量RM所提供的数值灵活性和概率可解释性。虽然最近的方法通过离线多任务学习结合这两种范式，但这种并行优化并不能保证生成的推理轨迹能积极地对齐或有助于下游标量奖励预测。为了解决这种不匹配，我们提出了LatentRM，这是一个奖励建模框架，它将中间推理轨迹学习为离散的潜变量，以显式最大化下游标量奖励的似然性。通过端到端对潜推理空间进行策略优化，LatentRM紧密地将基于深度推理的评估与精确评分结合起来。在分布内和分布外数据集以及RLHF上的大量验证表明，LatentRM在从开放式对话到复杂推理的各种任务中，在偏好建模和策略对齐方面均优于标量、生成式和混合RM。

articles.title: Authorship Verification of Transcribed German-Language Videos
articles.abstract: Authorship Verification (AV) represents an important subfield of digital text forensics and addresses the fundamental question of whether two texts were written by the same author. Although the field has made substantial progress over the past two decades, several important challenges remain unresolved or underexplored. For instance, most AV research has focused on written texts, despite the fact that language is expressed not only in written but also in spoken form, such as in videos. Moreover, existing AV studies have predominantly concentrated on English, while other languages, including German, have received comparatively little attention. To address these research gaps, we apply AV to spoken language in the form of transcripts of German-language videos and examine the effectiveness of established AV methods in verifying a speaker's identity across video pairs. Our experimental evaluation, based on a total of ten AV methods applied to three self-compiled corpora comprising 300 videos from 150 speakers, shows that the best performance (up to 88% accuracy and 90% AUC) is achieved by traditional AV approaches based on simple character- and token n-gram representations. In contrast, more modern transformer-based approaches perform significantly worse on all evaluated corpora. Our results therefore suggest that traditional methods in the field of AV remain both competitive and relevant.
articles.comment: 6 pages, planning to submit to WIFS 2026
articles.titleCn: 转录德语视频的作者身份验证
articles.abstractCn: 作者身份验证（AV）是数字文本取证的一个重要分支，它探讨两个文本是否由同一作者撰写的基本问题。尽管该领域在过去二十年取得了显著进展，但仍有一些重要挑战尚未解决或未得到充分探索。例如，尽管语言不仅以书面形式，也包括口语形式（如视频）表达，但大多数AV研究仍集中于书面文本。此外，现有的AV研究主要集中于英语，而德语等其他语言则相对较少受到关注。为解决这些研究空白，我们将AV应用于德语视频文本记录的口语语言，并检验了现有AV方法在跨视频对验证说话人身份方面的有效性。我们的实验评估基于三个自编语料库（包含150位说话人、300个视频），共应用了十种AV方法，结果显示传统AV方法基于简单的字符和词元n-gram表示，取得了最佳性能（准确率高达88%，AUC高达90%）。相比之下，更现代的基于transformer的方法在所有评估语料库上的表现均显著较差。因此，我们的结果表明，AV领域的传统方法仍然具有竞争力和相关性。

articles.title: M3-DuplexBench: A Multi-Turn, Multilingual, Multidomain Benchmark for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
articles.abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems (FDSDSs) can listen while speaking, enabling natural behaviors such as smooth turn-taking, backchannel handling, and user barge-in handling. However, fair comparisons in multi-turn conversations remain a challenge. In addition, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of languages and dialogue domains. We propose M3-DuplexBench, a multi-turn, multilingual, multidomain benchmark for FDSDSs. M3-DuplexBench supports English and Japanese and covers both casual conversation and multi-turn question answering. In addition, we evaluate models under multiple dialogue context settings, including single-turn, user-only, and teacher-forced full-context settings, to analyze how dialogue history affects model behavior. Experiments with recent FDSDSs reveal model-specific turn-taking characteristics, clear performance gaps across languages and domains, and mixed effects of dialogue context.
articles.titleCn: M3-DuplexBench：一个多轮次、多语言、多领域的全双工语音对话模型基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 全双工语音对话系统（FDSDS）能够边说边听，支持自然行为，如流畅的轮流发言、反馈处理和用户打断处理。然而，在多轮对话中进行公平比较仍然是一个挑战。此外，现有基准在语言和对话领域覆盖有限。我们提出了M3-DuplexBench，一个用于FDSDS的多轮、多语言、多领域基准。M3-DuplexBench支持英语和日语，涵盖休闲对话和多轮问答。此外，我们在多种对话上下文设置下评估模型，包括单轮、仅用户和教师强制全上下文设置，以分析对话历史如何影响模型行为。近期FDSDS的实验揭示了模型特定的轮流发言特征、跨语言和领域的明显性能差距，以及对话上下文的混合效果。

articles.title: Can Zero-Shot LLMs Predict Child Malnutrition? A Fairness and Temporal Robustness Study
articles.abstract: Child malnutrition remains a major public health challenge in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in South Asia, where early identification of vulnerable children is critical for timely intervention and resource allocation. This study aims to evaluate the feasibility, fairness, and temporal robustness of using a pretrained large language model (LLM) in a zero-shot setting for child stunting prediction using population health survey data. Using Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey (BDHS) data collected between 2007 and 2022, we transformed maternal, child, healthcare, and household characteristics into semantically interpretable prompt-based representations and evaluated GPT-4o-mini for zero-shot stunting prediction, comparing its performance against a random forest baseline and assessing fairness across demographic and socioeconomic groups as well as temporal robustness across survey waves. The results demonstrate that zero-shot inference using GPT-4o-mini achieved comparable balanced accuracy to the supervised baseline while exhibiting substantially higher sensitivity for identifying stunting cases, relatively consistent performance across child sex groups, and stable predictive behaviour across BDHS waves; however, important fairness disparities were observed across residence and household wealth categories, highlighting the need for further investigation before deployment of foundation models in public health prediction settings.
articles.titleCn: 零样本LLM能否预测儿童营养不良？一项关于公平性和时间鲁棒性的研究
articles.abstractCn: 儿童营养不良仍然是低收入和中等收入国家的一个主要公共卫生挑战，特别是在南亚地区，早期识别脆弱儿童对于及时干预和资源分配至关重要。本研究旨在评估在零样本设置中使用预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）基于人口健康调查数据预测儿童发育迟缓的可行性、公平性和时间稳定性。利用2007年至2022年期间收集的孟加拉国人口与健康调查（BDHS）数据，我们将母亲、儿童、医疗保健和家庭特征转化为语义可解释的基于提示的表示，并评估了GPT-4o-mini在零样本发育迟缓预测中的表现，将其性能与随机森林基线进行了比较，并评估了跨人口和社会经济群体以及跨调查波次的公平性和时间稳定性。结果表明，GPT-4o-mini的零样本推理实现了与监督基线相当的平衡精度，同时表现出显著更高的敏感性以识别发育迟缓病例，在儿童性别组中表现相对一致，并在BDHS波次中表现出稳定的预测行为；然而，在居住地和家庭财富类别中观察到重要的公平性差异，这突出了在公共卫生预测环境中部署基础模型之前进行进一步研究的必要性。

articles.title: Faster but Different: Diagnosing and Controlling Content Drift in Accelerated Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Training-free acceleration makes diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) more deployable, but it may silently change generated content. We study this serving-time consistency problem on 300 real images, comparing Fast-dLLM outputs with the same model's unaccelerated outputs. Across the mild parallelism induced in our long-form setting (1.05--1.25 committed tokens per step), confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but not baseline agreement. State-refresh ablations and an image-swap intervention instead identify stale visual and generated-text states as contributors to drift. For the tested Fast-dLLM implementation, shortening the KV-cache refresh interval yields a monotonic speed--agreement frontier and near-exact agreement at a measured 1.3x speedup. The initial diagnosis also appears with dLLM-Cache and LaViDa, although dLLM-Cache recovers agreement only after both caches are tightened, which removes its speed advantage. Independent prompts and images reproduce the threshold-insensitivity and refresh recovery. A targeted audit finds genuine content substitution in half of 50 low-agreement pairs. In a separate blinded two-annotator evaluation, the pooled accelerated-minus-baseline factual-error difference is 0.00 (95% CI [-0.17,+0.17]); this sample detects no difference but does not establish factual equivalence. Finally, none of the tested adaptive or smoothed-refresh variants beats the fixed interval at matched compute. Our contribution is a paired diagnostic and an implementation-scoped consistency control, not an accuracy or safety guarantee.
articles.titleCn: 更快但不同：诊断和控制加速多模态扩散语言模型中的内容漂移
articles.abstractCn: 无训练加速使基于扩散的多模态大语言模型（dMLLM）更具部署性，但可能会无声地改变生成内容。我们在300张真实图像上研究服务时一致性问题，比较Fast-dLLM输出与其相同模型的未加速输出。在我们的长文本设置中（每步1.05--1.25个承诺token的轻微并行性），置信度阈值调整改变了解码行为，但未改变基线一致性。状态刷新消融实验和图像交换干预则识别出陈旧视觉和生成文本状态是漂移的贡献因素。对于测试的Fast-dLLM实现，缩短KV缓存刷新间隔产生单调的速度-一致性前沿，并在1.3倍速度提升下实现近乎完全的一致性。初始诊断同样出现在dLLM-Cache和LaViDa中，尽管dLLM-Cache仅在两个缓存都收紧后才恢复一致性，从而丧失了其速度优势。独立提示和图像重现了阈值不敏感性和刷新恢复现象。针对性审计发现50组低一致性对中有一半存在真实内容替换。在单独的盲法双标注员评估中，加速减去基线的聚合事实性错误差异为0.00（95% CI [-0.17,+0.17]）；该样本未检测到差异，但未证实事实性等价性。最后，所有测试的自适应或平滑刷新变体在匹配计算量下均未超越固定间隔。我们的贡献是一对一诊断和实施范围内的致密性控制，而非准确度或安全保证。

articles.title: Semantics of Subterfuge: Benchmarking Legal Deception Detection Against General-domain State-of-the-Art
articles.abstract: Deception detection has critical implications for legal proceedings, law enforcement, and online security. Although human judgment is limited in accuracy and scalability, Natural Language Processing (NLP) offers a data-driven alternative. We present a survey and comparative analysis of NLP-based Automatic Deception Detection (ADD) focusing on the legal domain, reviewing the evolution from feature-based machine learning to Large Language Model (LLM) approaches. We conduct a unified empirical evaluation across seven datasets (two legal, five general-domain), comparing six fine-tuned transformer models and seven LLMs under four prompting strategies. The results show strong domain sensitivity, with fine-tuned models excelling in data-rich general domains and few-shot LLMs remaining competitive in low-resource legal settings. Chain-of-Thought prompting often underperforms direct classification. These findings highlight the need for domain adaptation and interpretable systems in high-stakes legal contexts.
articles.titleCn: 诡计的语义学：以通用领域最先进技术为基准检测法律欺骗
articles.abstractCn: 欺骗检测对法律诉讼、执法和网络安全具有重大意义。尽管人类判断在准确性和可扩展性上存在局限，自然语言处理（NLP）提供了数据驱动的替代方案。我们针对法律领域，对基于NLP的自动欺骗检测（ADD）进行了综述和比较分析，回顾了从基于特征的机器学习到大型语言模型（LLM）方法的演变。我们在七个数据集（两个法律领域，五个通用领域）上进行了统一的实证评估，比较了六种微调的Transformer模型和七种LLM在四种提示策略下的表现。结果表明存在强烈的领域敏感性，微调模型在数据丰富的通用领域表现优异，而少样本LLM在低资源法律环境中仍具有竞争力。思维链提示策略通常表现不如直接分类。这些发现强调了在高风险法律环境中进行领域适应和可解释系统的必要性。

articles.title: Tokenizer-Agnostic Engram Module
articles.abstract: Deepseek's Engram, a conditional memory module, was introduced to trade-off storage versus reasoning in large language models. However, the module relies on token-level $N$-gram hashing for Engram embedding lookup, introducing a tight coupling to the tokenizer used: a model with a different tokenizer would have to train its own Engram embeddings from scratch. To improve the reusability of Engram embeddings, we propose a change to the hashing routine, enabling compatibility between Engram models using different tokenizers. Instead of modelling disjoint $N$-gram spaces, we treat $N$-gram as a method to sample potentially useful byte sequences, from all possible byte sequences across tokens. We replace the XOR-based hashing with the general polynomial hashing with a joint embedding space across $N$. This work investigates the possible trade-offs and shows that this simple substitution produces comparable performance and achieves tokenizer-agnosticism: hash equivalence for byte-equivalent token sequences.
articles.titleCn: 与分词器无关的编码模块
articles.abstractCn: Deepseek的Engram模块，一个条件记忆模块，被引入以在大型语言模型中权衡存储与推理。然而，该模块依赖于基于token级别的N-gram哈希进行Engram嵌入查找，从而与所使用的分词器产生紧密耦合：一个使用不同分词器的模型必须从头开始训练其Engram嵌入。为了提高Engram嵌入的可重用性，我们提出对哈希过程进行修改，以实现使用不同分词器的Engram模型之间的兼容性。我们不再将N-gram建模为互斥的N-gram空间，而是将N-gram视为一种从所有可能的token字节序列中采样潜在有用字节序列的方法。我们用跨N的联合嵌入空间的通用多项式哈希替换基于XOR的哈希。这项工作研究了可能的权衡，并表明这种简单的替换产生了相当的性能，并实现了分词器无关性：对于字节等效的token序列，哈希值是等价的。

articles.title: From Inline Notes to Collected Commentaries: Toward Context-Preserving Organization of Exegetical Knowledge in Classical Chinese Texts
articles.abstract: Inline notes and collected commentaries are important forms of scholarly communication that evolved within the Confucian exegetical tradition, yet have received little computational attention. Drawing on traditional Chinese exegetics and philology, this paper formulates collected commentary compilation as an NLP task and proposes a computational framework that preserves the contextual dependency of inline notes while enabling their automatic compilation and exegetical knowledge organization. It combines two-step prompt chaining for identifying the associated main-text segments and exegetical functions of annotations with cross-source mention clustering for integrating commentary across editions, achieving a CoNLL F1 score above 97% in a case study on the Classic of Mountains. Our framework lays the foundation for the large-scale organization of historical exegetical knowledge, thereby supporting a broad range of downstream philological and NLP tasks.
articles.titleCn: 从行注到集成评注：迈向古典中文文本诠释知识语境化组织的路径
articles.abstractCn: 内联注释和集解是儒家诠释传统中发展起来的学术交流重要形式，但很少受到计算领域的关注。本文借鉴传统中国诠释学和文献学，将集解编纂视为一项自然语言处理任务，并提出一个计算框架，该框架在保留内联注释上下文依赖性的同时，能够实现其自动编纂和诠释知识组织。该框架结合了两步提示链用于识别注释关联的主文段落和诠释功能，以及跨源提及聚类用于整合不同版本的集解，在《山经》案例研究中实现了超过97%的CoNLL F1分数。我们的框架为历史诠释知识的规模化组织奠定了基础，从而支持广泛的下游文献学和自然语言处理任务。

articles.title: TransMem: Transforming Hidden States into Memory for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long interaction histories, where effective reasoning requires identifying and exploiting task-relevant evidence distributed across past observations and actions. However, useful information encoded in previously computed representations is often underutilized during subsequent generation. We propose \textbf{TransMem}, a lightweight inference-time parametric memory module that transforms sparse historical hidden states from a frozen LLM backbone into reusable memory representations. TransMem uses a lightweight gating network to dynamically apply the latent intervention to the current hidden states, without repeatedly encoding the preceding context. To learn transferable memory utilization rather than task-specific knowledge, we introduce evidence-conditioned self-distillation. A memory-augmented student processes the full context and matches the predictive distribution of an evidence-only teacher that shares the same frozen backbone. Experiments on LoCoMo, HotpotQA, and MemoryAgentBench demonstrate consistent improvements across different model architectures and scales. TransMem yields gains of 11.58--29.25 $F_1$ on LoCoMo and 10.20--13.03 $F_1$ on HotpotQA, while improving the average MemoryAgentBench accuracy from 29.54\% to 40.00\%. These results establish sparse historical hidden states as an effective and efficient memory substrate for long-context LLM agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/Haodong-Lei-Ray/TransMem.
articles.titleCn: TransMem：将隐藏状态转化为记忆，用于大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地处理长交互历史，其中有效的推理需要识别和利用分布在过去的观察和行动中的任务相关证据。然而，先前计算表示中编码的有用信息在后续生成过程中往往未被充分利用。我们提出了 \textbf{TransMem}，这是一种轻量级的推理时参数化内存模块，它将冻结的LLM主干网络中的稀疏历史隐藏状态转换为可重用的内存表示。TransMem使用一个轻量级的门控网络，动态地将潜在干预应用于当前的隐藏状态，而无需重复编码前面的上下文。为了学习可迁移的内存利用率而不是特定任务的知识，我们引入了证据条件自蒸馏。一个增强记忆的学生处理完整上下文，并匹配一个仅使用证据的、共享相同冻结主干的教师的预测分布。在LoCoMo、HotpotQA和MemoryAgentBench上的实验表明，在不同的模型架构和规模上均取得了持续改进。TransMem在LoCoMo上获得了11.58--29.25 $F_1$ 的提升，在HotpotQA上获得了10.20--13.03 $F_1$ 的提升，同时将MemoryAgentBench的平均准确率从29.54\%提高到40.00\%。这些结果确立了稀疏历史隐藏状态作为长上下文LLM代理的有效且高效的内存基础。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Haodong-Lei-Ray/TransMem 获得。

articles.title: GoldenRetriever: Non-Interactive Homomorphic Encrypted Retrieval for Privacy-Preserving RAG
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models by incorporating external knowledge, but existing pipelines typically operate on plaintext data, raising significant privacy concerns. Prior work on privacy-preserving retrieval leverages cryptographic techniques such as homomorphic encryption (HE) and private information retrieval (PIR), but often relies on interactive protocols or ranking-based selection mechanisms that incur high latency and potential information leakage. In this paper, we propose a practical non-interactive encrypted retrieval framework for RAG based on threshold selection. Instead of performing expensive top-$k$ ranking under encryption, our approach selects documents whose similarity scores exceed a predefined threshold, reducing computational complexity from quadratic to linear in the corpus size. We implement this design using CKKS-based homomorphic computation, enabling fully encrypted similarity evaluation and document selection without revealing query content, intermediate scores, or selected indices. To bridge the gap between approximate encrypted computation and discrete token reconstruction, we introduce a precision-stable mask polarization method that ensures accurate recovery of selected documents. Experiments on standard retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive retrieval effectiveness while significantly reducing latency compared to ranking-based encrypted methods. These results highlight threshold-based selection as a practical foundation for scalable and secure RAG systems.
articles.titleCn: 金毛寻回犬：用于隐私保护的非交互式同态加密检索
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识来提升大型语言模型，但现有流程通常处理明文数据，引发严重的隐私问题。先前在隐私保护检索方面的研究利用同态加密（HE）和私有信息检索（PIR）等密码学技术，但往往依赖交互式协议或基于排名的选择机制，导致高延迟和信息泄露风险。本文提出了一种基于阈值选择的实用非交互式加密检索框架，用于RAG。我们的方法无需在加密状态下执行昂贵的top-k排名，而是选择相似度得分超过预设阈值的文档，将计算复杂度从二次方降至语料库大小的线性关系。我们采用基于CKKS的同态计算实现该设计，支持完全加密的相似度评估和文档选择，同时不泄露查询内容、中间得分或选中索引。为弥合近似加密计算与离散标记重建之间的差距，我们引入了一种精度稳定的掩码极化方法，确保选中文档的准确恢复。在标准检索基准测试中，我们的方法在显著降低与基于排名的加密方法相比的延迟的同时，实现了具有竞争力的检索效果。这些结果突显了基于阈值选择作为可扩展且安全RAG系统的实用基础。

articles.title: Adjudicated Captioning: Multi-Agent Alignment Scoring and Consensus-Distilled Beam Arbitration for Strict Zero-Shot Image Captioning
articles.abstract: Zero-shot image captioning (ZIC) describes images without paired image-caption supervision during captioner training, relying on text-only corpora and frozen pretrained image-text scorers. Existing retrieval-augmented methods score image-text alignment once, at retrieval, then commit the captioner's autoregressive beam under language-model probability alone, leaving the decoder without further visual grounding feedback. Progress has stalled, with no method improving on the strict-regime best since 2024. We propose Adjudicated Captioning, an inference-time multi-agent framework that restores grounding feedback at multiple checkpoints over an unchanged IFCap captioner. First, we install a stronger frozen Retrieval Encoder at the input. Second, between retrieval and decoding we insert a frozen Cross-Attention Verifier that re-ranks the top-9 retrievals to top-5. Third, at the output beam we attach a learned Reranker pairing TriFuse, a multilayer perceptron, with MemAttend, a memory-attended transformer, the pipeline's only learned components; both are trained self-supervised by Borda-consensus distillation across the three frozen scorers, using no paired image-caption labels and no reference captions. Under the inductive headline protocol, with rerankers fit on the disjoint COCO Karpathy validation beam and applied frozen to test, the framework reaches CIDEr 117.6 and SPICE 21.9 on COCO Karpathy, up from 108.0 and 20.3 for IFCap, a +9.6 CIDEr gain, and +7.7 above NES, the strongest synthetic-image-augmented method at 109.9, without retraining the captioner. A training-free fixed-fusion baseline reaches 115.8 CIDEr, so +7.8 of the +9.6 gain comes from the non-learned architectural intervention and the remaining +1.8 from the learned rerankers. The same recipe transfers off-COCO without captioner retraining: +8.1 CIDEr on Flickr30k Karpathy and +5.7 on NoCaps overall.
articles.titleCn: 判例字幕：多智能体对齐评分与共识蒸馏束仲裁，用于严格的零样本图像字幕生成
articles.abstractCn: 零样本图像描述（ZIC）在描述图像时，在描述器训练过程中无需配对的图像-文本监督，仅依赖纯文本语料库和冻结的预训练图像-文本评分器。现有的检索增强方法在检索时仅对图像-文本对齐进行一次评分，然后仅根据语言模型概率提交描述器的自回归束，导致解码器缺乏进一步的视觉基础反馈。自2024年以来，该领域的发展停滞不前，没有方法在严格的最佳条件下有所改进。我们提出了裁决式描述（Adjudicated Captioning），这是一个推理时的多智能体框架，在不变的IFCap描述器上在多个检查点恢复基础反馈。首先，我们在输入端安装了一个更强的冻结检索编码器。其次，在检索和解码之间，我们插入了一个冻结的交叉注意力验证器，将前9个检索结果重新排序为前5个。第三，在输出束上，我们附加了一个学习的重新排序器，将多层感知器TriFuse与记忆注意力Transformer MemAttend配对，这是管道中唯一的学习组件；两者均通过跨三个冻结评分器的 borda 一致性蒸馏进行自监督训练，无需配对的图像-文本标签和参考描述。在归纳性标题协议下，重新排序器在COCO Karpathy的独立验证束上进行训练，并在测试中应用冻结，该框架在COCO Karpathy上达到CIDEr 117.6和SPICE 21.9，而IFCap的得分分别为108.0和20.3，CIDEr提升了9.6，高于NES（109.9），NES是最强的合成图像增强方法，提升了7.7。一个无训练的固定融合基线达到115.8 CIDEr，因此+9.6提升中的+7.8来自非学习的架构干预，剩余的+1.8来自学习到的重新排序器。同样的方法可以无缝迁移到COCO之外，无需重新训练描述器：在Flickr30k Karpathy上提升8.1 CIDEr，在NoCaps上整体提升5.7。

articles.title: PARALLEL: A Prefrontal-Aligned Reinforcement inspired Approach for Language-Model Learning under Explicit Limits
articles.abstract: Recent language models achieve strong performance across a variety of tasks, but conventional adaptation applies updates uniformly across training samples regardless of their local update benefit. We propose PARALLEL, a prefrontal-aligned reinforcement inspired approach for language-model learning. Inspired by the complementary roles of goal-related and uncertainty-related control, PARALLEL represents these forms of information as separate controller signals and combines them with the current model representation. A reinforcement-inspired controller assigns sample-dependent update intensity using immediate utility-cost feedback. PARALLEL therefore learns when and how strongly to adapt to each sample, prioritizing beneficial updates while limiting unnecessary parameter changes. PARALLEL uses available updates more efficiently than selective baselines while retaining 94.1--99.2\% of Full-adaptation performance. Beyond multiple-choice reasoning, experiments on XSum and CNN/DailyMail show that PARALLEL retains 96.9--98.6\% of the ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 scores achieved by Full adaptation and 98.8--98.9\% of the corresponding ROUGE-L scores. When compared at the same cumulative adaptation time or GPU energy, PARALLEL achieves higher ARC accuracy and exhibits a more stable late-stage adaptation trajectory than Full adaptation in the representative run. These results show that learning when and how strongly to update each sample supports stable and efficient post-deployment stream adaptation while avoiding unnecessary updates.
articles.titleCn: 并行：一种受前额叶对齐强化启发的语言模型学习方法，在明确限制下进行
articles.abstractCn: 近期语言模型在各种任务中取得了优异的性能，但传统的自适应方法会不加区分地统一更新训练样本，而不管它们各自的局部更新效益如何。我们提出了PARALLEL，一种受前额叶皮层对齐强化启发的语言模型学习方法。受目标相关控制和不确定性相关控制互补作用的启发，PARALLEL将这些信息形式表示为独立的控制器信号，并将它们与当前模型表示相结合。受强化启发的控制器使用即时效用成本反馈来分配样本相关的更新强度。因此，PARALLEL学习何时以及如何强烈地适应每个样本，优先考虑有益的更新，同时限制不必要的参数变更。与选择性基线相比，PARALLEL更有效地利用可用更新，同时保留了94.1--99.2%的全适应性能。除了多项选择推理之外，在XSum和CNN/DailyMail上的实验表明，PARALLEL保留了96.9--98.6%的全适应ROUGE-1和ROUGE-2得分，以及98.8--98.9%的相应ROUGE-L得分。在相同的累积适应时间或GPU能耗下比较时，PARALLEL在代表性运行中实现了更高的ARC准确率，并表现出比全适应更稳定的后期适应轨迹。这些结果表明，学习何时以及如何强烈地更新每个样本，支持稳定高效的部署后流式适应，同时避免了不必要的更新。

articles.title: Mixture-of-Translators: Translating KV Caches Across Heterogeneous Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Heterogeneous Large Language Model (LLM) systems increasingly rely on shared contexts, retrieved evidence, and multi-agent dialogue histories, yet their internal key-value (KV) caches remain model-specific and cannot be reused across architectures. Consequently, each model must repeatedly prefill or store caches for the same context, limiting the scalability of multi-model reasoning and long-context generation. We propose Mixture-of-Translators(MoT), a cache translation framework that maps context KV caches from a source LLM into the cache space of a target LLM. Unlike prior approaches that depend on a single projection path or global shared latent space, MoT uses multiple translator modules to capture diverse source--target mappings. To further reduce residual translation error, we introduce a Context Correction Loss that aligns the replayed target trajectory with the native target trajectory. We reveal two competing failure modes in cache translation: propagated translation shift from early injection and last-state shift from late injection. MoT addresses them through translator mixtures and target-side correction. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous translations among Qwen2.5, GPT-2, and OPT models, MoT preserves downstream QA performance, including Qwen2.5-7B-scale translation with 51.0% average closed-set QA accuracy and 0.43 average extractive QA F1. In practical case studies, MoT enables quality-preserving memory reuse for multi-agent reasoning and retains 96.3% of direct-context quality in long-context cache-augmented generation, demonstrating scalable KV cache reuse across heterogeneous LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 混合翻译器：跨异构大型语言模型翻译 KV 缓存
articles.abstractCn: 异构大型语言模型（LLM）系统越来越依赖共享上下文、检索证据和多智能体对话历史，但它们的内部键值（KV）缓存仍然是模型特定的，无法跨架构重用。因此，每个模型都必须重复为相同上下文预填充或存储缓存，这限制了多模型推理和长上下文生成的可扩展性。我们提出了混合翻译器（MoT），这是一个缓存翻译框架，它将源LLM的上下文KV缓存映射到目标LLM的缓存空间中。与依赖单一投影路径或全局共享潜在空间的先前方法不同，MoT使用多个翻译模块来捕获多样化的源-目标映射。为了进一步减少残差翻译误差，我们引入了上下文校正损失，使重放的目標轨迹与原生目標轨迹对齐。我们揭示了缓存翻译中的两种竞争性失效模式：早期注入导致的传播翻译偏移和晚期注入导致的最后状态偏移。MoT通过翻译器混合和目标侧校正来解决这些问题。在Qwen2.5、GPT-2和OPT模型之间的同构和异构翻译中，MoT保留了下游QA性能，包括51.0%平均闭集QA准确率的Qwen2.5-7B规模翻译和0.43平均提取式QA F1。在实际案例研究中，MoT实现了多智能体推理的质量保留内存重用，并在长上下文缓存增强生成中保留了96.3%的直接上下文质量，展示了跨异构LLM的可扩展KV缓存重用。

articles.title: BLADE: Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large language models often improve task performance by generating long reasoning traces, but the resulting computation is frequently wasted on redundant verification and revision. Existing probe-based early-exit approaches mainly inspect explicit self-doubt expressions, leaving many earlier termination opportunities undetected. Expanding inspection to ordinary reasoning boundaries improves coverage, but also exposes highly diverse intermediate states whose predictive information may reside in different hidden layers. We present Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning (BLADE), a lightweight framework that dynamically terminates reasoning by estimating whether the generated prefix is sufficient for correct answering. BLADE constructs multi-granular checkpoints from sentence, self-doubt, and paragraph boundaries, and derives robust training labels through repeated answer completions. It further learns a compact subset of informative probe layers instead of relying on fixed choices or expensive representations from all layers. At inference time, calibrated predictions are combined with checkpoint-specific confirmation rules to balance responsiveness and premature-exit risk. Experiments on five benchmarks and two Qwen3 reasoning models show that BLADE preserves near-baseline accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 24.8% on Qwen3-8B and 15.8% on Qwen3-4B. Ablation studies further confirm the benefits of diverse checkpoints and automatic layer selection, demonstrating an effective approach to more efficient LLM reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 刀片：边界扩展和层自适应动态出口，用于高效的大型语言模型推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通常通过生成长推理轨迹来提升任务性能，但由此产生的计算往往浪费在冗余的验证和修正上。现有的基于探测的提前退出方法主要检查显式的自我怀疑表达，导致许多早期的终止机会未被检测到。将检查扩展到普通的推理边界可以提高覆盖率，但也暴露了高度多样化的中间状态，其预测信息可能存在于不同的隐藏层中。我们提出了边界扩展和层自适应动态退出框架（BLADE），这是一个轻量级框架，通过估计生成的前缀是否足以正确回答来动态终止推理。BLADE从句子、自我怀疑和段落边界构建多粒度检查点，并通过重复答案补全推导出鲁棒的训练标签。它进一步学习信息丰富的探测层紧凑子集，而不是依赖固定的选择或所有层的高昂表示。在推理时，校准的预测与特定检查点的确认规则相结合，以平衡响应性和过早退出风险。在五个基准测试和两个Qwen3推理模型上的实验表明，BLADE在保持接近基线准确率的同时，在Qwen3-8B上减少了24.8%的生成token，在Qwen3-4B上减少了15.8%。消融研究进一步证实了多样化检查点和自动层选择的好处，展示了一种更高效的大型语言模型推理方法。

articles.title: FairFund-Bench: Evaluating Distributive Bias in LLM Resource Allocation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in the distribution of scarce resources, raising concerns about biased allocations based on characteristics like race and gender. Recent LLM audits have produced inconsistent results, however, finding evidence of both positive and negative discrimination towards women and ethnic minorities, even for the same models. We show that this disagreement can arise from differences in audit format and introduce FairFund-Bench, a benchmark that systematically varies key features of previous audit designs: the evaluation task (rating, ranking, or allocation), comparison context (single or multi-stimulus), and whether the audit is transparent or disguised. The benchmark comprises 600 requests for financial assistance created from human-authored templates (calibrated against 1.3M real GoFundMe campaigns) across three domains, four race and two gender categories, and five causal framings of need derived from welfare deservingness theory. Across 14 models, audit format changes the direction of bias: models advantage minorities when rating claimants individually but penalize some groups when ranking them side by side. Bias magnitude, though small overall, is several times greater in disguised audits than in transparent ones, where, faced with appeals differing only in claimants' names, models overwhelmingly split funds equally. Causal framing effects, by contrast, exceed demographic effects by roughly an order of magnitude and are consistent across models and audit formats, indicating that current LLMs robustly reproduce human deservingness evaluations. The benchmark scores models on four criteria (demographic bias, deservingness alignment, cross-task consistency, and cross-context consistency), is publicly available, and can be readily adapted to other substantive domains.
articles.titleCn: FairFund-Bench：评估LLM资源分配中的分配性偏见
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地参与到稀缺资源的分配中，引发了基于种族和性别等特征的分配偏见的担忧。然而，最近的LLM审计结果却存在不一致性，发现针对女性和少数族裔的正面和负面歧视证据，即使是对同一模型也是如此。我们表明，这种分歧可能源于审计格式的差异，并介绍了FairFund-Bench，这是一个基准测试，系统地改变了先前审计设计的关键特征：评估任务（评分、排序或分配）、比较背景（单一或多重刺激）以及审计是否透明或伪装。该基准测试包含600个来自人类编写的模板（经过对130万真实GoFundMe活动进行校准）的财务援助请求，涵盖三个领域、四个种族和两个性别类别，以及源自福利应得性理论的五种需求因果框架。在14个模型中，审计格式的变化改变了偏见的方向：模型在单独评估索赔人时有利于少数族裔，但在并列排序时惩罚某些群体。尽管总体上偏见幅度很小，但在伪装审计中，偏见幅度比透明审计大几倍，在透明审计中，面对仅索赔人姓名不同的呼吁时，模型几乎总是平均分配资金。相比之下，因果框架效应的规模大致超过了人口统计效应一个数量级，并且在所有模型和审计格式中保持一致，表明当前的LLM稳健地复制了人类的应得性评估。该基准测试根据四个标准（人口统计偏见、应得性一致性、跨任务一致性和跨背景一致性）对模型进行评分，是公开可用的，并且可以很容易地适应其他实质性领域。

articles.title: Token-Level Diagnosis of Sycophancy in LLMs with Attribution-Guided Steering
articles.abstract: Sycophancy refers to the tendency for large language models (LLMs) to match user beliefs at the cost of factual correctness, thereby undermining model reliability. Prior work on evaluating sycophancy in LLMs aims to assess whether a model's output matches an authority's claim, but cannot reveal which part of the prompt drives this sycophantic behavior. To bridge this gap, we investigate the relationship of sycophantic responses with an authority's credentials, their assertive claim, and the problem statement. We introduce the Authority Share Index (ASI), an Integrated Gradients-based token attribution method, which measures the degree to which a model's decision is driven by authority-related text. Through extensive experiments across five models and 30 test configurations, we find that sycophantic responses consistently direct more attention toward authority tokens than resistant ones. Moreover, our token attribution method reveals that for the sycophantic cases, the claim asserted by the authority receives more attention than the authority's credentials. Building on these findings, we propose attribution-guided contrastive activation steering to mitigate LLM sycophancy. Our method constructs a steering vector from high-attribution tokens of sycophantic and resistant responses, selectively pushing models toward resistance. This enables inference-time steering without retraining, lowering sycophancy from 96% to 25% in the strongest case. Together, our results show that token-level attribution can both explain what drives sycophancy and directly inform a practical intervention.
articles.titleCn: 基于归因引导的LLM奉承行为的token级诊断
articles.abstractCn: 谄媚性是指大型语言模型（LLM）为了迎合用户信念而牺牲事实准确性，从而削弱模型可靠性的倾向。以往关于评估LLM谄媚性的研究旨在判断模型的输出是否与权威的声明相符，但无法揭示是提示中的哪一部分驱动了这种谄媚行为。为了弥补这一差距，我们研究了谄媚性回应与权威资质、其断言声明以及问题描述之间的关系。我们引入了权威份额指数（ASI），这是一种基于集成梯度的标记归因方法，用于衡量模型决策在多大程度上受到与权威相关的文本驱动。通过在五个模型和30种测试配置上进行的大量实验，我们发现谄媚性回应始终比抗拒性回应更多地关注权威标记。此外，我们的标记归因方法揭示，在谄媚性案例中，权威所断言的声明比权威的资质获得更多关注。基于这些发现，我们提出了归因引导的对比激活引导方法来缓解LLM谄媚性。我们的方法从谄媚性和抗拒性回应的高归因标记中构建引导向量，选择性地将模型推向抗拒方向。这使得在不重新训练的情况下实现推理时引导，在最强案例中将谄媚性从96%降低到25%。综合来看，我们的结果表明，标记级归因不仅能解释驱动谄媚性的因素，还能直接为实际干预提供指导。
